DISCUSSION: Although PET typically identifies inflammatory disease, this case suggests that fluorodeoxyglucose uptake may also occur in ATTR.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Diagnosis of ATTR often requires multimodality imaging to identify and differentiate from other infiltrative cardiomyopathies. Cardiac PET, although not classically used for this application, may have utility in the diagnostic pathway.

AI.tldr: 一例72岁房颤消融术后室性心律失常患者，心脏PET高度提示心脏结节病，但电压指导心内膜心肌活检确诊为ATTR淀粉样变，提示FDG摄取可见于ATTR。
AI.motivation: 转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变（ATTR）是错误折叠的转甲状腺素蛋白沉积于心肌所致的浸润性心肌病，诊断通常依赖锝-99m显像或心脏磁共振。既往认为氟脱氧葡萄糖（FDG）PET主要用于识别炎症性疾病（如心脏结节病），ATTR是否也可出现FDG摄取、PET在ATTR诊断路径中的价值尚不明确，存在被误诊为结节病的风险。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（JACC Case Rep）。对象为72岁男性，因房颤消融术后多源性室性早搏及非持续性室性心动过速接受评估。行心脏PET检查，并进一步行电压指导的心内膜心肌活检获取组织学诊断。摘要未报告具体影像参数、活检取材部位数量及统计方法（为描述性病例报告）。
AI.result: 心脏PET结果高度提示心脏结节病；但电压指导的心内膜心肌活检组织学确诊为ATTR淀粉样变。摘要未报告FDG摄取的定量数值（如SUV）、受累节段及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 本病例提示FDG-PET虽经典用于炎症性疾病，但ATTR也可出现FDG摄取，可能导致误诊为心脏结节病；ATTR诊断常需多模态影像并结合组织活检以鉴别其他浸润性心肌病。对电生理实践而言，房颤消融术后出现室性心律失常并伴PET阳性者，在考虑结节病前应警惕ATTR。局限性为单例报告，不能推断发生率或因果关系。

summary_zh:
背景：转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性（ATTR）是一种浸润性心肌病，由错误折叠的转甲状腺素蛋白沉积于心肌所致。诊断通常依赖于锝-99m显像或磁共振成像。

病例摘要：一名72岁男性因心房颤动消融后出现多源性室性期前收缩和非持续性室性心动过速就诊评估。心脏正电子发射断层扫描（PET）高度提示心脏结节病。然而，电压引导的心内膜心肌活检获得了ATTR的组织学诊断。

讨论：尽管PET通常用于识别炎症性疾病，但本病例提示氟脱氧葡萄糖摄取也可能发生于ATTR。

要点：ATTR的诊断通常需要多模态成像以识别并与其他浸润性心肌病相鉴别。心脏PET虽经典上并非用于此用途，但可能在诊断路径中具有应用价值。

title: Stellate Ganglion Block Reduces the Incidence of Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is associated with sympathetic overactivity. Stellate ganglion is a potential target for intervention.

OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study was to examine the efficacy of preemptive left stellate ganglion block (SGB) in reducing POAF in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting with cardiopulmonary bypass.

METHODS: Patients were randomized to the SGB group or the control group. The primary endpoint was the incidence of POAF within 5 days postoperatively. Secondary endpoints included POAF-associated characteristics and recovery indicators.

RESULTS: A total of 124 patients underwent initial randomization, with 108 in modified intention-to-treat and 98 in per-protocol analysis. In modified intention-to-treat analysis, POAF occurred in 18.5% of the SGB group and 44.4% of the control group (OR: 0.288; 95% CI: 0.106-0.731; P = 0.007). Per-protocol analysis yielded consistent results. SGB group showed significantly lower POAF burden, shorter duration of first POAF episode, fewer POAF episodes and antiarrhythmic treatments, decreased C-reactive protein, interleukin-6, high-sensitivity cardiac troponin T, and creatine kinase-MB on certain postoperative time points, and decreased postoperative hospitalization than the control group (all P < 0.05). Exploratory subgroup analyses suggested that the association between SGB pretreatment and lower POAF incidence was more pronounced among patients without diabetes (OR: 0.10; 95% CI: 0.019-0.480; P = 0.004) and those at lower baseline risk of POAF (OR: 0.10; 95% CI: 0.005-0.642; P = 0.040).

CONCLUSIONS: In patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting with cardiopulmonary bypass, preemptive left SGB was associated with a reduced incidence of POAF within 5 postoperative days. Exploratory subgroup analyses suggested a potentially greater association among patients without diabetes and those at lower risk of POAF.

AI.tldr: 预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞可降低体外循环冠脉搭桥术后5天内房颤发生率（18.5% vs 44.4%），并减少房颤负荷及炎症指标。
AI.motivation: 术后房颤（POAF）与交感神经过度激活相关，星状神经节是潜在干预靶点，但预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞（SGB）在冠脉搭桥术后房颤中的疗效尚不明确。
AI.method: 随机对照研究，纳入行体外循环冠脉搭桥术的患者，随机分为SGB组或对照组。主要终点为术后5天内POAF发生率；次要终点包括POAF特征及恢复指标。共124例初始随机，改良意向性治疗分析108例，符合方案分析98例。
AI.result: 改良意向性治疗分析中，SGB组POAF发生率为18.5%，对照组为44.4%（OR 0.288；95% CI 0.106-0.731；P=0.007），符合方案分析结果一致。SGB组POAF负荷更低、首次发作持续时间更短、发作次数及抗心律失常治疗更少，术后某些时间点C反应蛋白、白介素-6、高敏肌钙蛋白T和肌酸激酶-MB降低，术后住院时间缩短（均P<0.05）。探索性亚组分析提示，无糖尿病患者（OR 0.10；95% CI 0.019-0.480；P=0.004）及基线POAF风险较低者（OR 0.10；95% CI 0.005-0.642；P=0.040）中关联更明显。
AI.conclusion: 在体外循环冠脉搭桥术患者中，预防性左侧SGB与术后5天内POAF发生率降低相关，并改善多项恢复指标。探索性亚组提示无糖尿病及低风险患者可能获益更大。需进一步研究确认其机制及适用人群。

summary_zh:
背景：术后心房颤动（POAF）与交感神经过度活跃有关。星状神经节是潜在的干预靶点。

目的：本研究旨在探讨预防性左侧星状神经节阻滞（SGB）在降低接受体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术患者POAF方面的疗效。

方法：患者被随机分配到SGB组或对照组。主要终点是术后5天内POAF的发生率。次要终点包括POAF相关特征和恢复指标。

结果：共有124例患者接受了初步随机化，其中108例纳入改良意向治疗分析，98例纳入符合方案分析。在改良意向治疗分析中，SGB组POAF发生率为18.5%，对照组为44.4%（OR：0.288；95% CI：0.106-0.731；P = 0.007）。符合方案分析得出了一致的结果。与对照组相比，SGB组显示出显著更低的POAF负荷、首次POAF发作持续时间更短、POAF发作次数和抗心律失常治疗更少、在某些术后时间点C反应蛋白、白细胞介素-6、高敏心肌肌钙蛋白T和肌酸激酶-MB降低，以及术后住院时间缩短（所有P < 0.05）。探索性亚组分析提示，SGB预处理与较低POAF发生率之间的关联在无糖尿病患者（OR：0.10；95% CI：0.019-0.480；P = 0.004）和基线POAF风险较低的患者（OR：0.10；95% CI：0.005-0.642；P = 0.040）中更为明显。

结论：在接受体外循环冠状动脉旁路移植术的患者中，预防性左侧SGB与术后5天内POAF发生率降低相关。探索性亚组分析提示，在无糖尿病患者和POAF风险较低的患者中，这种关联可能更强。

title: Increased Heart Failure Risk After Low-Voltage-Area Ablation in Patients With Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation
summary: Background Extensive atrial ablation may impair atrial function; however, its impact on long-term heart failure (HF) risk remains unclear.Objectives This study sought to evaluate the association between low-voltage area (LVA) ablation and HF outcomes after catheter ablation for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AF).Methods This was a long-term follow-up analysis of the Volatile Coronary Lesion and Obstructive Nodal Atrial Fibrillation trial. A total of 398 patients were followed for up to 7 years and classified into 3 groups: no LVAs (group A), LVAs with LVA ablation (group B), and LVAs without LVA ablation (group C). The primary outcome was HF hospitalization.Results During a median follow-up of 1,660 (735-2,555) days, HF hospitalization occurred in 21 patients. Sinus rhythm was maintained in 96% of patients, with no differences among groups (P = 0.26). Patients with LVAs had a higher incidence of HF hospitalization than those without (18% vs 3%; P < 0.001). Among patients with LVAs, HF hospitalization occurred more frequently in those undergoing LVA ablation (30% vs 6%; P = 0.01). In a competing-risk analysis accounting for all-cause death, the cumulative incidence of HF hospitalization remained significantly higher in patients undergoing LVA ablation (Gray's test, P = 0.042). Among patients who experienced HF hospitalization, most events occurred during documented sinus rhythm.Conclusions Among patients with paroxysmal AF and LVAs, LVA ablation was associated with a higher incidence of HF hospitalization despite a high rate of sinus rhythm maintenance. Given the limited sample size and number of events, these findings should be considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating, and warrant confirmation in larger prospective studies.

AI.tldr: 在阵发性房颤伴低电压区患者中，低电压区消融与更高的心衰住院风险相关（30% vs 6%），尽管窦性心律维持率高达96%。
AI.motivation: 广泛心房消融可能损害心房功能，但其对长期心衰风险的影响尚不明确。本研究旨在评估低电压区（LVA）消融与阵发性房颤导管消融后心衰结局的关联。
AI.method: 本研究为Volatile Coronary Lesion and Obstructive Nodal Atrial Fibrillation试验的长期随访分析，共纳入398例患者，随访长达7年，分为三组：无LVA组（A组）、有LVA并接受LVA消融组（B组）、有LVA未接受LVA消融组（C组）。主要终点为心衰住院。采用竞争风险分析（考虑全因死亡）评估累积发生率。
AI.result: 中位随访1660（735-2555）天，21例发生心衰住院。窦性心律维持率96%，组间无差异（P=0.26）。有LVA患者心衰住院率高于无LVA患者（18% vs 3%，P<0.001）。在有LVA患者中，接受LVA消融者心衰住院更频繁（30% vs 6%，P=0.01）。竞争风险分析显示，LVA消融组心衰住院累积发生率仍显著更高（Gray's检验，P=0.042）。多数心衰住院事件发生在记录到的窦性心律期间。
AI.conclusion: 在阵发性房颤伴LVA患者中，LVA消融与更高的心衰住院发生率相关，尽管窦性心律维持率高。鉴于样本量和事件数有限，这些发现应视为探索性和假设生成性，需更大规模前瞻性研究证实。

summary_zh:
背景：广泛的心房消融可能损害心房功能；然而，其对长期心力衰竭（HF）风险的影响仍不清楚。

目的：本研究旨在评估阵发性心房颤动（AF）导管消融后低电压区（LVA）消融与HF结局之间的关联。

方法：这是Volatile Coronary Lesion and Obstructive Nodal Atrial Fibrillation试验的长期随访分析。共398例患者随访长达7年，分为3组：无LVA（A组）、有LVA并接受LVA消融（B组）和有LVA但未接受LVA消融（C组）。主要结局为HF住院。

结果：在中位随访1,660（735-2,555）天期间，21例患者发生HF住院。96%的患者维持窦性心律，组间无差异（P = 0.26）。有LVA的患者HF住院发生率高于无LVA者（18% vs 3%；P < 0.001）。在有LVA的患者中，接受LVA消融者HF住院更频繁（30% vs 6%；P = 0.01）。在考虑全因死亡的竞争风险分析中，接受LVA消融的患者HF住院的累积发生率仍显著更高（Gray's检验，P = 0.042）。在发生HF住院的患者中，大多数事件发生在有记录的窦性心律期间。

结论：在阵发性AF合并LVA的患者中，尽管窦性心律维持率高，LVA消融与更高的HF住院发生率相关。鉴于样本量和事件数有限，这些发现应视为探索性和假设生成性，需要在更大规模的前瞻性研究中确认。

title: Impact of Interelectrode Spacing on Ventricular Tachycardia Substrate Mapping: Insights Into 3-Dimensional Characteristics of the Arrhythmogenic Substrate
summary: Background Re-entrant ventricular tachycardia (VT) circuits often involve 3-dimensional activation across the endocardium, epicardium, and mid-myocardium, highlighting the importance of comprehensive substrate assessment. Wider interelectrode spacing may incorporate broader-field electrical components that are less apparent on conventional closely spaced recordings.Objectives This study sought to investigate the electrophysiological impact of interelectrode spacing on substrate mapping and its potential implications for 3-dimensional features of VT substrate.Methods Sixty-eight high-density substrate maps from 35 patients undergoing catheter ablation for scar-related VT were retrospectively analyzed. Closely spaced (2-mm) and widely spaced (8-mm) bipolar electrograms were simultaneously acquired using a decapolar catheter and used to generate closely and widely spaced bipolar electrode maps (CEM and WEM).Results Compared with CEM, WEM, which incorporates a greater contribution of far-field components, demonstrated higher bipolar amplitudes, a greater prevalence of multicomponent electrograms, and a lower prevalence of split potentials (all P < 0.01). Lines of block delineated by split potentials on CEM were frequently attenuated or no longer apparent on WEM because the corresponding electrograms appeared fragmented and lacked a distinct split configuration. In an exploratory analysis of 6 VTs with evaluable activation maps, activation gaps were larger with closely than widely spaced bipolar mapping (32.5% vs 20.0%; P = 0.03). In 4 VTs, widely spaced recordings identified diastolic or presystolic far-field potentials not evident with closely spaced recordings.Conclusions Widely spaced bipolar electrograms may provide complementary functional information beyond that obtained with conventional near-field recordings by incorporating broader-field electrical components, thereby offering additional insight into the potential 3-dimensional characteristics of the arrhythmogenic substrate.

AI.tldr: 在瘢痕相关室速基质标测中，8mm宽间距双极电图较2mm常规间距可记录到更多远场成分，改变阻滞线和激活裂隙的识别，提示其可补充三维基质信息。
AI.motivation: 折返性室速环路常涉及心内膜、心外膜和壁内的三维激动，需要全面评估基质。常规紧密间距双极记录可能遗漏更宽范围的远场电成分，而宽间距记录对室速基质三维特征的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 回顾性分析35例因瘢痕相关室速接受导管消融患者的68幅高密度基质图。使用十极导管同步采集2mm紧密间距和8mm宽间距双极电图，分别生成紧密间距双极电图图（CEM）和宽间距双极电图图（WEM）。比较两种标测的双极振幅、多成分电图、分裂电位等特征；并对6例可评估激动图的室速分析激活裂隙，对4例室速分析远场电位。
AI.result: 与CEM相比，WEM的双极振幅更高、多成分电图更常见、分裂电位更少见（均P<0.01）。CEM上由分裂电位标出的阻滞线在WEM上常减弱或消失，相应电图呈碎裂且缺乏明确分裂形态。在6例可评估激动图的室速中，紧密间距标测的激活裂隙大于宽间距标测（32.5% vs 20.0%；P=0.03）。在4例室速中，宽间距记录识别出紧密间距记录未显现的舒张期或收缩前期远场电位。
AI.conclusion: 宽间距双极电图通过纳入更宽范围的远场电成分，可提供常规近场记录之外的补充功能信息，有助于理解致心律失常基质的三维特征。但本研究为回顾性、小样本探索性分析，宽间距标测对消融策略和临床结局的影响尚需前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：折返性室性心动过速（VT）环路常涉及心内膜、心外膜和心肌中层之间的三维激动，这凸显了全面评估基质的重要性。较宽的电极间距可能纳入更宽场电学成分，而这些成分在常规紧密间距记录中不太明显。

目的：本研究旨在探讨电极间距对基质标测的电生理影响及其对VT基质三维特征的潜在意义。

方法：回顾性分析35例因瘢痕相关VT接受导管消融患者的68幅高密度基质图。使用十极导管同时采集紧密间距（2 mm）和宽间距（8 mm）双极电图，并用于生成紧密间距和宽间距双极电极图（CEM和WEM）。

结果：与CEM相比，WEM纳入更多远场成分的贡献，表现出更高的双极振幅、多成分电图更常见以及分裂电位更少见（所有P < 0.01）。CEM上由分裂电位勾画的阻滞线在WEM上常被减弱或不再明显，因为相应电图表现为碎裂且缺乏明显的分裂构型。在对6例可评估激动图的VT进行的探索性分析中，紧密间距双极标测的激动间隙大于宽间距标测（32.5% vs 20.0%；P = 0.03）。在4例VT中，宽间距记录识别出紧密间距记录未显现的舒张期或收缩前期远场电位。

结论：宽间距双极电图通过纳入更宽场电学成分，可能提供超越常规近场记录所获得的功能信息，从而为致心律失常基质的潜在三维特征提供额外见解。

title: Back to the past? Hybrid AF ablation in the era of modern catheter techniques
summary: Maintaining sinus rhythm is challenging in persistent atrial fibrillation (AF), where atrial remodeling and mechanisms beyond pulmonary vein triggers may require more extensive ablation.However, evidence supporting additional lesion sets remains inconsistent.The 2024 European Society of Cardiology guidelines therefore retain pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the cornerstone of catheter ablation while acknowledging uncertainty regarding the optimal strategy in non-paroxysmal AF [1].Marini et al. [2] prospectively evaluated staged endo-epicardial ablation in 89 patients with persistent or long-standing persistent AF, involving a mean of 2.1 procedures per patient.Continuous implantable loop recorder (ILR) monitoring showed freedom from AF recurrence declining from 84.2% at 6 months to 48.5% at 3 years, although most patients maintained an AF burden below 5% and symptoms improved despite recurrence [2].Their systematic use of ILRs deserves recognition: by capturing asymptomatic recurrences and quantifying AF burden, continuous monitoring provides a more informative assessment than intermittent electrocardiographic monitoring.

AI.tldr: 在89例持续性或长程持续性房颤患者中，分期心内外膜联合消融后，经植入式循环记录仪监测的无房颤复发率从6个月的84.2%降至3年的48.5%，但多数患者房颤负荷仍低于5%且症状改善。
AI.motivation: 持续性房颤维持窦性心律困难，心房重构及肺静脉以外的触发机制可能需要更广泛的消融，但额外消融 lesion set 的证据不一致；2024年ESC指南仍将肺静脉隔离（PVI）作为导管消融的基石，同时承认非阵发性房颤最佳策略尚不明确。
AI.method: Marini等开展前瞻性研究，纳入89例持续性或长程持续性房颤患者，采用分期心内外膜联合消融策略，平均每例接受2.1次手术；使用连续植入式循环记录仪（ILR）监测复发，主要观察无房颤复发率及房颤负荷，并评估症状变化。
AI.result: 连续ILR监测显示，无房颤复发率从6个月的84.2%下降至3年的48.5%；尽管存在复发，大多数患者房颤负荷维持在5%以下，症状改善。摘要未报告置信区间及P值。
AI.conclusion: 分期心内外膜联合消融在持续性房颤中3年无复发率不足半数，但多数患者房颤负荷低且症状改善；系统性使用ILR可捕捉无症状复发并量化房颤负荷，较间断心电监测提供更有价值的信息，对电生理实践中消融策略选择与术后监测方式具有启示，但需注意单中心、样本量有限及缺乏对照的局限性。

summary_zh: 在持续性心房颤动（AF）中，维持窦性心律具有挑战性，因为心房重构和肺静脉触发以外的机制可能需要更广泛的消融。然而，支持额外消融 lesion 集的证据仍不一致。因此，2024年欧洲心脏病学会指南仍将肺静脉隔离（PVI）作为导管消融的基石，同时承认在非阵发性AF中最佳策略存在不确定性[1]。Marini等[2]前瞻性评估了89例持续性或长程持续性AF患者的分期心内膜-心外膜消融，每位患者平均接受2.1次手术。连续植入式循环记录仪（ILR）监测显示，无AF复发率从6个月时的84.2%下降至3年时的48.5%，尽管大多数患者的AF负荷保持在5%以下，且尽管复发但症状改善[2]。他们系统性地使用ILR值得认可：通过捕捉无症状复发并量化AF负荷，连续监测提供了比间歇性心电图监测更具信息性的评估。

title: Comparative Efficacy of Rebamipide, Pantoprazole, and Their Combination for Gastroprotection in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation Receiving Direct Oral Anticoagulants: The Randomized REGATA Study.
summary: Background: Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) receiving direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC) are at an elevated risk of gastrointestinal (GI) mucosal damage and bleeding. Proton pump inhibitors (PPI) are conventional gastroprotectors, but their efficacy in the lower GI tract is limited. This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of rebamipide monotherapy and combination pantoprazole-rebamipide (P + R) therapy compared to pantoprazole monotherapy in this vulnerable population. Methods: In the randomized, parallel-group, open-label, single-center REGATA trial, 210 AF patients receiving DOAC were randomized (1:1:1) to three gastroprotective regimens (n = 70 each) for 24 weeks: pantoprazole monotherapy, rebamipide monotherapy, or their combination. Efficacy analyses were performed in the per-protocol population (n = 118: pantoprazole, n = 36; rebamipide, n = 39; P + R, n = 43). The primary and secondary outcomes included composite clinical GI events (bleeding classified by ISTH/BARC, ulcers/erosions, and severe dyspepsia) and biomarkers of mucosal barrier function (fecal zonulin and calprotectin). Results: The incidence of primary efficacy endpoint events was 13.9% (n = 5; 95% CI: 3.1-25.7) in the pantoprazole group, 10.3% (n = 4; 95% CI: 2.3-21.1) in the rebamipide group, and 9.3% (n = 4; 95% CI: 2.1-18.6) in the P + R group, successfully confirming the non-inferiority hypothesis for both experimental arms within the pre-specified margin of 10% (p < 0.05). Multivariable regression analysis showed that compared with pantoprazole monotherapy, rebamipide monotherapy demonstrated an odds ratio OR of 0.71 (95% CI: 0.18-2.88, p = 0.630), while the P + R therapy was associated with an OR of 0.64 (95% CI: 0.16-2.57, p = 0.525). No major GI bleeding events or fatalities occurred; a single episode of GI bleeding (ISTH minor/BARC Type 2) was recorded in the pantoprazole arm (2.8%). Fecal calprotectin levels significantly decreased in the rebamipide group (by 37.6%, from 139 to 78 µg/g; p < 0.001) and the P + R group (by 50.0%, from 135 to 61 µg/g; p < 0.001), while no significant changes were observed in the pantoprazole group (p = 0.530). Concurrently, fecal zonulin levels, reflecting intestinal epithelial permeability, fell by 45.1% in the rebamipide arm (from 434 to 225 ng/mL; p < 0.001) and by 47.1% in the P + R arm (from 347 to 182 ng/mL; p < 0.001) compared to a minimal 3.0% fluctuation in the pantoprazole group. Conclusions: While demonstrating non-inferiority regarding primary clinical endpoints, both rebamipide monotherapy and combination (P + R) therapy achieved some advantages over pantoprazole monotherapy in decreasing subclinical GI inflammation and restoring intestinal epithelial barrier integrity.

AI.tldr: 在服用DOAC的房颤患者中，瑞巴派特单药及联合泮托拉唑在临床胃肠道事件上不劣于泮托拉唑单药，且能更显著降低粪便钙卫蛋白和连蛋白水平。
AI.motivation: 房颤患者服用DOAC时胃肠道黏膜损伤和出血风险升高，PPI是常用胃保护剂但下消化道效果有限，需要评估瑞巴派特单药及联合PPI的疗效与安全性。
AI.method: 随机、平行组、开放标签、单中心REGATA试验，210例服用DOAC的房颤患者按1:1:1随机接受泮托拉唑单药、瑞巴派特单药或联合治疗24周，每组70例；符合方案集118例（泮托拉唑36例、瑞巴派特39例、联合43例）。主要和次要终点为复合临床胃肠道事件（按ISTH/BARC分类的出血、溃疡/糜烂、严重消化不良）及黏膜屏障功能生物标志物（粪便连蛋白和钙卫蛋白）。
AI.result: 主要疗效终点事件发生率：泮托拉唑组13.9%（5例，95%CI 3.1-25.7），瑞巴派特组10.3%（4例，95%CI 2.3-21.1），联合组9.3%（4例，95%CI 2.1-18.6），在预设10%非劣效界值内证实非劣效（p<0.05）。多变量回归显示，与泮托拉唑单药相比，瑞巴派特单药OR 0.71（95%CI 0.18-2.88，p=0.630），联合治疗OR 0.64（95%CI 0.16-2.57，p=0.525）。无重大胃肠道出血或死亡；泮托拉唑组记录1例胃肠道出血（ISTH轻微/BARC 2型，2.8%）。粪便钙卫蛋白在瑞巴派特组下降37.6%（139降至78 µg/g，p<0.001），联合组下降50.0%（135降至61 µg/g，p<0.001），泮托拉唑组无显著变化（p=0.530）。粪便连蛋白在瑞巴派特组下降45.1%（434降至225 ng/mL，p<0.001），联合组下降47.1%（347降至182 ng/mL，p<0.001），泮托拉唑组仅波动3.0%。
AI.conclusion: 瑞巴派特单药及联合泮托拉唑在主要临床终点上不劣于泮托拉唑单药，且在降低亚临床胃肠道炎症和恢复肠上皮屏障完整性方面优于泮托拉唑单药。这为服用DOAC的房颤患者提供了潜在的胃保护新选择，但研究为开放标签、单中心、符合方案集样本量较小，需更大规模随机对照试验验证。

summary_zh:
背景：接受直接口服抗凝药（DOAC）治疗的房颤（AF）患者发生胃肠道（GI）黏膜损伤和出血的风险升高。质子泵抑制剂（PPI）是常规的胃黏膜保护剂，但其在下消化道中的疗效有限。本研究评估了瑞巴派特单药治疗以及泮托拉唑联合瑞巴派特（P + R）治疗与泮托拉唑单药治疗相比，在该脆弱人群中的疗效和安全性。

方法：在随机、平行组、开放标签、单中心的REGATA试验中，210例接受DOAC的AF患者被随机（1:1:1）分配至三种胃黏膜保护方案（每组n = 70），为期24周：泮托拉唑单药治疗、瑞巴派特单药治疗或两者联合治疗。疗效分析在符合方案集人群中进行（n = 118：泮托拉唑组n = 36；瑞巴派特组n = 39；P + R组n = 43）。主要和次要结局包括复合临床GI事件（按ISTH/BARC分类的出血、溃疡/糜烂和严重消化不良）以及黏膜屏障功能的生物标志物（粪便连蛋白和钙卫蛋白）。

结果：主要疗效终点事件的发生率在泮托拉唑组为13.9%（n = 5；95% CI：3.1-25.7），在瑞巴派特组为10.3%（n = 4；95% CI：2.3-21.1），在P + R组为9.3%（n = 4；95% CI：2.1-18.6），成功证实了两个实验组在预设的10%界值内均具有非劣效性（p < 0.05）。多变量回归分析显示，与泮托拉唑单药治疗相比，瑞巴派特单药治疗的比值比OR为0.71（95% CI：0.18-2.88，p = 0.630），而P + R治疗相关的OR为0.64（95% CI：0.16-2.57，p = 0.525）。未发生重大GI出血事件或死亡；泮托拉唑组记录到一例GI出血（ISTH次要/BARC 2型）（2.8%）。粪便钙卫蛋白水平在瑞巴派特组显著下降（下降37.6%，从139降至78 µg/g；p < 0.001）和P + R组（下降50.0%，从135降至61 µg/g；p < 0.001），而泮托拉唑组未观察到显著变化（p = 0.530）。同时，反映肠上皮通透性的粪便连蛋白水平在瑞巴派特组下降45.1%（从434降至225 ng/mL；p < 0.001），在P + R组下降47.1%（从347降至182 ng/mL；p < 0.001），而泮托拉唑组仅有3.0%的微小波动。

结论：虽然在主要临床终点方面表现出非劣效性，但瑞巴派特单药治疗和联合（P + R）治疗在减少亚临床GI炎症和恢复肠上皮屏障完整性方面均较泮托拉唑单药治疗取得了一定优势。

title: Longitudinal Plasma Lipidomic Changes in Chinese Patients with Nonvalvular Atrial Fibrillation During 12 Weeks of Edoxaban Treatment.
summary: Introduction: Altered lipid metabolism is implicated in atrial fibrillation, but longitudinal lipidomic changes during anticoagulation remain poorly characterized. Objectives: To characterize plasma lipidomic changes during 12 weeks of edoxaban treatment and explore associated metabolic pathways in Chinese patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation (NVAF). Methods: This prespecified substudy of a prospective multicenter study analyzed fasting predose plasma collected at baseline and week 12 from 74 patients receiving protocol-assigned edoxaban doses (15 mg, n = 3; 30 mg, n = 23; 60 mg, n = 48). Widely targeted UPLC-MS/MS lipid profiling, with laboratory quality control (QC CV < 30%), yielded 1099 lipid features retained for statistical analysis. Differential lipids were defined by paired testing with Benjamini-Hochberg correction (|log2FC| > 0.58 and q < 0.05). Results: The overall, 30 mg, and 60 mg analyses identified 25, 15, and 35 FDR-significant features, respectively; none was significant in the exploratory 15 mg group. Twelve features were shared across the primary analyses and increased at week 12; they comprised mainly acylcarnitines, together with docosadienoic acid and DG (21:0/16:0/0:0), and four lacked HMDB identifiers. The corresponding FDR panels yielded participant-grouped out-of-fold AUCs of 0.918 (95% CI 0.890-0.963), 0.786 (0.701-0.890), and 0.891 (0.835-0.950) for discriminating baseline from week 12, respectively. Pathway mapping identified no multi-compound enriched pathways (q < 0.05). Observed annotations represented single-metabolite signals-most notably DG (21:0/16:0/0:0) (HMDB0094301) and octanoylcarnitine (HMDB0000791)-rather than coordinated, pathway-level alterations. Conclusions: Paired analyses identified consistent longitudinal plasma lipidomic changes in patients receiving edoxaban. The 12 shared features provide focused candidates for targeted validation. Controlled studies are needed to determine whether these changes are specific to edoxaban and to establish their biological and clinical relevance.

AI.tldr: 中国非瓣膜性房颤患者接受依度沙班治疗12周后，血浆脂质组出现以酰基肉碱为主的12种一致性升高特征，但无通路水平富集。
AI.motivation: 脂代谢异常与房颤相关，但抗凝治疗期间纵向脂质组变化特征不明，缺乏中国非瓣膜性房颤患者接受依度沙班治疗后的脂质组动态数据。
AI.method: 前瞻性多中心研究的预设亚组分析，纳入74例中国非瓣膜性房颤患者，按方案接受依度沙班15mg（n=3）、30mg（n=23）或60mg（n=48）治疗，采集基线和第12周空腹给药前血浆，采用广泛靶向UPLC-MS/MS脂质组学检测（QC CV<30%），保留1099个脂质特征进行配对检验，Benjamini-Hochberg校正定义差异脂质（|log2FC|>0.58且q<0.05），并评估判别基线与第12周的AUC及通路富集。
AI.result: 总体、30mg和60mg分析分别鉴定出25、15和35个FDR显著特征，15mg探索组无显著特征；12个特征在主要分析中共享且第12周升高，主要为酰基肉碱，以及二十二碳二烯酸和DG(21:0/16:0/0:0)，其中4个缺乏HMDB标识。相应FDR面板区分基线与第12周的参与者分组折外AUC分别为0.918（95%CI 0.890-0.963）、0.786（0.701-0.890）和0.891（0.835-0.950）。通路映射未发现多化合物富集通路（q<0.05），观察到的注释为单代谢物信号，最显著为DG(21:0/16:0/0:0)（HMDB0094301）和辛酰基肉碱（HMDB0000791）。
AI.conclusion: 配对分析显示依度沙班治疗患者存在一致的纵向血浆脂质组变化，12个共享特征可作为靶向验证的候选标志物；但需对照研究明确这些变化是否特异于依度沙班及其生物学与临床意义，且通路水平改变不明显，15mg组样本量过小限制解释。

summary_zh: 引言：脂质代谢改变与心房颤动有关，但抗凝治疗期间纵向脂质组学变化仍特征不明。目的：描述中国非瓣膜性心房颤动（NVAF）患者接受依度沙班治疗12周期间血浆脂质组学变化特征，并探索相关代谢通路。方法：这项前瞻性多中心研究的预设亚组分析，分析了74例接受方案指定依度沙班剂量（15 mg，n = 3；30 mg，n = 23；60 mg，n = 48）患者基线和第12周采集的空腹给药前血浆。广泛靶向UPLC-MS/MS脂质谱分析，实验室质量控制（QC CV < 30%），获得1099个脂质特征用于统计分析。差异脂质通过配对检验结合Benjamini-Hochberg校正定义（|log2FC| > 0.58且q < 0.05）。结果：总体、30 mg和60 mg分析分别识别出25、15和35个FDR显著特征；探索性15 mg组无显著特征。12个特征在主要分析中共有并在第12周升高；它们主要包括酰基肉碱，以及二十二碳二烯酸和DG (21:0/16:0/0:0)，其中四个缺乏HMDB标识符。相应的FDR组合分别产生参与者分组折外AUC为0.918（95% CI 0.890-0.963）、0.786（0.701-0.890）和0.891（0.835-0.950），用于区分基线与第12周。通路映射未识别出多化合物富集通路（q < 0.05）。观察到的注释代表单代谢物信号——最显著的是DG (21:0/16:0/0:0)（HMDB0094301）和辛酰基肉碱（HMDB0000791）——而非协调的通路水平改变。结论：配对分析识别出接受依度沙班患者一致的纵向血浆脂质组学变化。12个共有特征为靶向验证提供了聚焦候选物。需要对照研究来确定这些变化是否特定于依度沙班，并确立其生物学和临床相关性。

title: Esophageal Temperature Changes During Pulsed Field Ablation With Three Catheter Systems.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is considered less thermally injurious than conventional ablation technologies, but esophageal temperature elevation can still occur. Human data directly comparing esophageal temperature changes among different PFA catheter systems remain limited. We compared esophageal temperature changes during PFA using VARIPULSE, PulseSelect, and FARAPULSE.

METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included consecutive patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation who underwent pulmonary vein isolation using PFA with luminal esophageal temperature monitoring between April 2025 and March 2026. Esophageal temperature was measured at five sites every 0.5 s. For each patient, esophageal temperature rise (ΔT) was defined as the maximum esophageal temperature recorded during PFA minus the mean esophageal temperature during the 5-min interval immediately preceding the PFA application associated with that maximum temperature. A sensitivity analysis using the same ΔT definition was performed in patients who underwent pulmonary vein isolation alone.

RESULTS: A total of 70 patients were analyzed. ΔT differed among the three groups and was greatest with VARIPULSE (1.61 ± 1.00°C vs. 1.10 ± 0.61°C vs. 0.88 ± 0.43°C for VARIPULSE, PulseSelect, and FARAPULSE, respectively; p = 0.0302). In patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation alone (n = 56), ΔT remained significantly different among the three groups (1.61 ± 1.03°C vs. 1.05 ± 0.61°C vs. 0.74 ± 0.38°C, respectively; p = 0.0386). Clinically significant temperature elevation (ΔT ≥ 2.0°C) occurred most frequently with VARIPULSE in both the overall cohort and the pulmonary vein isolation-only subgroup. Temperature elevation was most prominent during ablation near the left pulmonary veins and in anatomically adjacent regions to the esophagus. No patient developed symptoms suggestive of esophageal ulceration; however, systematic post-procedural endoscopic assessment was not performed.

CONCLUSIONS: Measured esophageal temperature elevation during PFA differed according to catheter system and was greatest with VARIPULSE; this between-system difference persisted in patients undergoing pulmonary vein isolation alone. Because procedural characteristics differed among systems, these findings should not be interpreted as establishing a device-specific causal mechanism or esophageal safety.

AI.tldr: 在三种脉冲场消融（PFA）导管系统中，VARIPULSE 引起的食管温度升高幅度最大（ΔT 1.61°C），且该差异在仅行肺静脉隔离的患者中依然存在。
AI.motivation: PFA 被认为热损伤小于传统消融技术，但仍可能引起食管温度升高。目前直接比较不同 PFA 导管系统对食管温度影响的人体数据有限，临床需要明确不同系统间的食管热效应差异。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，连续纳入 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 3 月接受 PFA 肺静脉隔离的非瓣膜性房颤患者，术中行食管腔内温度监测（5 个位点，每 0.5 秒测量）。ΔT 定义为 PFA 期间记录的最高食管温度减去该次消融前 5 分钟平均食管温度。对仅行肺静脉隔离的患者进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 共分析 70 例患者。三组 ΔT 差异有统计学意义，VARIPULSE 组最大（1.61 ± 1.00°C vs. PulseSelect 1.10 ± 0.61°C vs. FARAPULSE 0.88 ± 0.43°C，p = 0.0302）。仅行肺静脉隔离的 56 例患者中，三组 ΔT 仍存在显著差异（1.61 ± 1.03°C vs. 1.05 ± 0.61°C vs. 0.74 ± 0.38°C，p = 0.0386）。临床显著温度升高（ΔT ≥ 2.0°C）在 VARIPULSE 组发生率最高。温度升高在左肺静脉附近及食管解剖毗邻区域消融时最明显。无患者出现提示食管溃疡的症状，但未进行系统性术后内镜评估。
AI.conclusion: PFA 期间食管温度升高幅度因导管系统而异，VARIPULSE 最高，且在仅行肺静脉隔离的患者中该差异持续存在。由于各系统手术特征不同，这些发现不能解释为设备特异性因果机制或食管安全性结论，需谨慎解读。

summary_zh:
背景：脉冲场消融（PFA）被认为比传统消融技术热损伤更小，但仍可能发生食管温度升高。直接比较不同PFA导管系统间食管温度变化的人体数据仍然有限。我们比较了使用VARIPULSE、PulseSelect和FARAPULSE进行PFA期间的食管温度变化。

方法：这项回顾性单中心研究连续纳入2025年4月至2026年3月期间接受PFA肺静脉隔离并进行了腔内食管温度监测的非瓣膜性心房颤动患者。每0.5秒在五个位点测量食管温度。对于每位患者，食管温度升高（ΔT）定义为PFA期间记录的最高食管温度减去与该最高温度相关的PFA应用前5分钟间隔内的平均食管温度。在仅接受肺静脉隔离的患者中，使用相同的ΔT定义进行了敏感性分析。

结果：共分析了70例患者。ΔT在三组间存在差异，VARIPULSE组最大（VARIPULSE、PulseSelect和FARAPULSE分别为1.61 ± 1.00°C vs. 1.10 ± 0.61°C vs. 0.88 ± 0.43°C；p = 0.0302）。在仅接受肺静脉隔离的患者中（n = 56），ΔT在三组间仍存在显著差异（分别为1.61 ± 1.03°C vs. 1.05 ± 0.61°C vs. 0.74 ± 0.38°C；p = 0.0386）。有临床意义的温度升高（ΔT ≥ 2.0°C）在总体队列和仅肺静脉隔离亚组中均最常见于VARIPULSE。温度升高在左肺静脉附近及与食管解剖相邻区域消融时最为显著。没有患者出现提示食管溃疡的症状；然而，未进行系统的术后内镜评估。

结论：PFA期间测得的食管温度升高因导管系统而异，VARIPULSE组最大；这种系统间差异在仅接受肺静脉隔离的患者中持续存在。由于各系统的手术特征不同，这些发现不应被解释为确立了设备特异性因果机制或食管安全性。

title: Contact Strategies and Isolation Endpoints in Pulsed Field Ablation of Persistent Left Superior Vena Cava: A Case Series.
summary: Persistent left superior vena cava (PLSVC) can trigger atrial fibrillation. Thermal ablation of this vessel carries risks of phrenic nerve palsy and coronary artery spasm, whereas pulsed field ablation still lacks procedural guidance for the PLSVC diameter taper, which narrows from the distal segment to a dilated coronary sinus ostium. We report two contact strategies applied in three patients: a guidewire-anchored rail with steerable sheath tension for a fixed-loop catheter, and loop-diameter adjustment for a variable-loop catheter. Acute bidirectional block was confirmed by pacing in all three cases; in one case, dissociated spontaneous potentials provided an endpoint more stringent than atrial fibrillation termination alone. No complications occurred. These findings provide initial guidance for ablating the tapered PLSVC, although long-term durability requires prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 三例持续性左上腔静脉相关房颤患者采用脉冲场消融，通过导丝锚定轨道或环径调整实现急性双向阻滞，无并发症。
AI.motivation: 持续性左上腔静脉（PLSVC）可触发房颤，但热消融存在膈神经麻痹和冠状动脉痉挛风险；脉冲场消融（PFA）对该血管从远端至扩张冠状窦口的锥形变径缺乏操作指导。
AI.method: 病例系列研究，纳入3例PLSVC相关房颤患者，应用两种接触策略：固定环导管采用导丝锚定轨道联合可调弯鞘张力，可变环导管采用环径调整；以起搏确认急性双向阻滞为主要终点，并观察并发症。
AI.result: 3例均经起搏确认急性双向阻滞；其中1例记录到分离的自发电位，提供了比单纯房颤终止更严格的终点；无并发症发生。摘要未报告长期随访及具体统计数值。
AI.conclusion: 针对锥形PLSVC的PFA接触策略可实现急性双向阻滞且安全，为临床操作提供初步指导；但长期耐久性需前瞻性研究验证，样本量小限制推广。

summary_zh: 持续性左上腔静脉（PLSVC）可触发心房颤动。对该血管进行热消融存在膈神经麻痹和冠状动脉痉挛的风险，而脉冲场消融对于PLSVC直径逐渐变细（从远端段向扩张的冠状窦口逐渐变窄）的情况仍缺乏操作指导。我们报告了应用于三例患者的两种接触策略：针对固定环导管采用导丝锚定的轨道配合可调弯鞘张力，以及针对可变环导管采用环直径调整。三例均通过起搏确认了急性双向阻滞；其中一例中，分离的自发电位提供了比单纯心房颤动终止更严格的终点。未发生并发症。这些发现为消融逐渐变细的PLSVC提供了初步指导，尽管长期耐久性仍需前瞻性验证。

title: Central Composite Design-Optimized Dabigatran Etexilate Cubosomes for Sustained Oral Release and Enhanced In Vivo Pharmacokinetics
summary: Objectives Dabigatran etexilate mesylate (DEM), a prodrug of the direct thrombin inhibitor dabigatran used for stroke prevention in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation, exhibits poor aqueous solubility, P-glycoprotein-mediated efflux, and limited oral bioavailability, which pose challenges for oral delivery. This study aimed to develop and optimize a cubosome-based nanocarrier system to enhance the oral bioavailability and sustain the release of DEM.Methods DEM-loaded cubosomes were prepared using glycerol monooleate (GMO) and Poloxamer 407 by melt dispersion-emulsification. A Central Composite Design (CCD) was employed to optimize formulation variables based on particle size, entrapment efficiency, and drug release responses. Optimized formulations were characterized by dynamic light scattering, TEM, FT-IR, DSC, and XRD analyses. In vitro drug release and in vivo pharmacokinetic studies in Wistar rats were performed to evaluate sustained release behavior and relative oral bioavailability enhancement.Results The optimized cubosomes exhibited nanoscale particle size (~ 19-30 nm), narrow size distribution, high entrapment efficiency (~ 87%), and sustained biphasic drug release up to 24 h. Structural characterization supported incorporation of DEM within the lipid matrix and reduced drug crystallinity. In vivo pharmacokinetic evaluation demonstrated prolonged plasma exposure and enhanced relative bioavailability compared with the marketed formulation, with approximately 2.28-fold higher relative bioavailability.Conclusions The optimized cubosomal system effectively improved the oral delivery and sustained release of DEM. The formulation demonstrated enhanced relative bioavailability and prolonged systemic exposure, supporting further development for oral DEM delivery. Anticoagulant efficacy, gastrointestinal safety, and appropriate dosing regimens remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并优化了达比加群酯脂质体立方晶纳米载体，在大鼠中实现24小时缓释，相对生物利用度较市售制剂提高约2.28倍。
AI.motivation: 达比加群酯甲磺酸盐（DEM）是直接凝血酶抑制剂达比加群的前药，用于非瓣膜性房颤卒中预防，但水溶性差、受P-糖蛋白外排影响、口服生物利用度有限，亟需改善口服递送策略。
AI.method: 采用熔融分散-乳化法制备载DEM的立方晶（cubosomes），以甘油单油酸酯和泊洛沙姆407为载体材料；采用中心复合设计（CCD）优化处方变量，响应指标为粒径、包封率和药物释放；对优化处方进行动态光散射、TEM、FT-IR、DSC和XRD表征；开展体外释放及Wistar大鼠体内药代动力学研究，评价缓释行为与相对口服生物利用度。
AI.result: 优化立方晶粒径约19-30 nm，分布窄，包封率约87%，体外呈双相缓释达24小时；结构表征支持DEM嵌入脂质基质且药物结晶度降低；大鼠体内药代动力学显示血浆暴露时间延长，相对生物利用度较市售制剂提高约2.28倍。
AI.conclusion: 优化立方晶系统有效改善了DEM的口服递送与缓释性能，提高了相对生物利用度并延长了全身暴露，支持进一步开发；但抗凝疗效、胃肠道安全性及合适给药方案尚待确立，且摘要未报告具体药代动力学参数及统计显著性。

summary_zh: 目的 甲磺酸达比加群酯（DEM）是直接凝血酶抑制剂达比加群的前体药物，用于非瓣膜性心房颤动的卒中预防，其水溶性差、存在P-糖蛋白介导的外排以及口服生物利用度有限，给口服给药带来挑战。本研究旨在开发并优化基于立方体的纳米载体系统，以提高DEM的口服生物利用度并实现缓释。方法 采用熔融分散-乳化法，以单油酸甘油酯（GMO）和泊洛沙姆407制备载DEM立方体。采用中心复合设计（CCD）基于粒径、包封率和药物释放响应优化处方变量。通过动态光散射、TEM、FT-IR、DSC和XRD分析对优化处方进行表征。进行体外药物释放和Wistar大鼠体内药代动力学研究，以评估缓释行为和相对口服生物利用度提高。结果 优化的立方体呈现纳米级粒径（约19-30 nm）、窄粒径分布、高包封率（约87%）以及长达24小时的持续双相药物释放。结构表征支持DEM掺入脂质基质并降低药物结晶度。体内药代动力学评估显示，与市售制剂相比，血浆暴露延长且相对生物利用度提高，相对生物利用度约高2.28倍。结论 优化的立方体系统有效改善了DEM的口服递送和缓释。该制剂表现出增强的相对生物利用度和延长的全身暴露，支持进一步开发用于DEM口服递送。抗凝疗效、胃肠道安全性和适当的给药方案仍有待确定。

title: [A case of giant esophageal hematoma after radiofrequency ablation for atrial fibrillation]
Impact of GLP1Ra and SGLT2i on atrial fibrillation in overweight, non-diabetic patients: A meta-analysis of randomized evidence
summary: Sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP1Ra) are breakthrough therapies for type 2 diabetes (T2DM), exhibiting pleiotropic effects. Their clinical use has expanded to lower-risk populations, including overweight and obese individuals without T2DM. However, although early intervention in dysmetabolic disease appears conceptually advantageous, clear evidence regarding the benefits of these treatments in overweight or obese individuals without diabetes, particularly for the prevention of atrial fibrillation (AF), remains lacking. Our meta-analysis addresses this unmet need by examining whether GLP1Ra and SGLT2i may help prevent AF in overweight or obese individuals without diabetes. A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) investigating the effect of GLP1Ra and SGLT2i on AF was conducted across 22 studies involving 45,171 participants (16,920 treated with GLP1Ra, 6,855 treated with SGLT2i, and 21,396 controls), all enrolling overweight patients without T2DM. The mean follow-up was 18.2 months. A primary analysis including both GLP1Ra and SGLT2i classes was performed. Exploratory analysis included subgroup comparisons of semaglutide versus other GLP1Ra (herein intended as both GLP1Ra and GLP1/GIP Ra). Sensitivity analysis comprised confirmatory analysis of the primary results, bias-addressing subgroup analysis, leave-one-out analysis, and temporal cumulative meta-analysis. Evidence sufficiency was assessed using a trial sequential analysis-like framework. Meta-regression analysis were performed to explore the impact of patient- and trial-related characteristics on AF. Available basic and translational evidence was discussed accordingly. The primary analysis did not demonstrate a reduction in AF/AFL risk with GLP1Ra treatment (RR 0.69, 95% CI 0.43–1.08; p = 0.097), although exploratory exclusion of the HFpEF trial unveiled a hypothesis-generating association with a lower AF/AFl risk (RR 0.52, 95% CI 0.29–0.94; p = 0.034). Interestingly, a robust, albeit exploratory, hypothesis-generating signal favouring semaglutide emerged repeatedly compared with other GLP1Ra (RR 0.41, 95% CI 0.19–0.85; p = 0.024; p for interaction = 0.003), whereas other incretin agonists exhibited a neutral effect (RR 1.34, 95% CI 0.74–2.41; p = 0.29). In contrast, SGLT2i showed no evidence of benefit (RR 1.11, 95% CI 0.88–1.42; p = 0.28), but the corresponding results appeared to be affected by substantial publication bias. The subgroup difference between GLP1Ra and SGLT2i was statistically significant (p = 0.035) although exploratory. Sensitivity analysis were broadly consistent and suggested that the semaglutide-associated signal was unlikely to be driven by model-dependent assumptions, large-trial effects, endpoint ascertainment methods, or the inclusion of HFpEF populations. Trial sequential analysis indicated that additional randomized controlled trials are required before definitive conclusions can be drawn. Current randomized evidence does not establish a reduction in AF/AFL risk among overweight or obese individuals without diabetes. However, exploratory analysis identified a hypothesis-generating signal suggesting a potential protective effect of GLP1Ra in populations without HFpEF. Among GLP-1RAs, sensitivity analysis further supported a resilient, hypothesis-generating association between semaglutide and a lower risk of AF/AFL, independent of population characteristics or large-size trial effect. An interclass difference favouring GLP1Ra repeatedly emerged, although its hypothesis-generating value is limited by the inconclusive SGLT2i evidence. Although supported by multiple sensitivity analysis, these findings remain exploratory and hypothesis-generating and therefore require confirmation in dedicated randomized trials with prespecified arrhythmic endpoints.

AI.tldr: 在超重或肥胖的非糖尿病人群中，GLP1Ra整体未显著降低房颤/房扑风险（RR 0.69，P=0.097），但探索性分析提示司美格鲁肽可能具有保护作用（RR 0.41，P=0.024），SGLT2i则无获益证据。
AI.motivation: GLP1Ra和SGLT2i在2型糖尿病治疗中显示出多效性，其应用已扩展至超重/肥胖但无糖尿病的低危人群。然而，这类药物能否预防该人群的房颤尚缺乏明确证据，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，纳入22项随机对照试验，共45,171例超重/肥胖的非2型糖尿病患者（GLP1Ra组16,920例，SGLT2i组6,855例，对照组21,396例），平均随访18.2个月。主要分析评估GLP1Ra和SGLT2i对房颤/房扑风险的影响；探索性分析比较司美格鲁肽与其他GLP1Ra；并进行敏感性分析、试验序贯分析及荟萃回归。
AI.result: 主要分析未显示GLP1Ra显著降低房颤/房扑风险（RR 0.69，95%CI 0.43–1.08；P=0.097）。排除HFpEF试验后，GLP1Ra与较低风险相关（RR 0.52，95%CI 0.29–0.94；P=0.034）。司美格鲁肽相比其他GLP1Ra显示出更优信号（RR 0.41，95%CI 0.19–0.85；P=0.024；交互P=0.003），而其他肠促胰素激动剂为中性效应（RR 1.34，95%CI 0.74–2.41；P=0.29）。SGLT2i无获益证据（RR 1.11，95%CI 0.88–1.42；P=0.28），但存在显著发表偏倚。GLP1Ra与SGLT2i亚组差异有统计学意义（P=0.035）。试验序贯分析提示需更多随机对照试验。
AI.conclusion: 当前随机证据未证实GLP1Ra或SGLT2i能在超重/肥胖非糖尿病人群中降低房颤/房扑风险。但探索性分析提示GLP1Ra（尤其是司美格鲁肽）在无HFpEF人群中可能具有保护作用，SGLT2i证据不确定。这些发现仅为假设生成，需专门设计以心律失常为终点的随机试验进一步验证。

summary_zh: 钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）和胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP1Ra）是2型糖尿病（T2DM）的突破性疗法，具有多效性作用。其临床使用已扩展至较低风险人群，包括无T2DM的超重和肥胖个体。然而，尽管在代谢异常疾病中早期干预在概念上似乎有益，但关于这些治疗在无糖尿病的超重或肥胖个体中的获益，特别是对心房颤动（AF）的预防，仍缺乏明确证据。我们的荟萃分析通过检验GLP1Ra和SGLT2i是否可能有助于预防无糖尿病超重或肥胖个体的AF，来满足这一未满足的需求。我们进行了一项系统综述和荟萃分析，纳入22项研究、涉及45,171名参与者（16,920名接受GLP1Ra治疗，6,855名接受SGLT2i治疗，21,396名对照），所有研究均纳入无T2DM的超重患者，旨在探讨GLP1Ra和SGLT2i对AF的影响。平均随访时间为18.2个月。进行了包括GLP1Ra和SGLT2i两类药物的主要分析。探索性分析包括司美格鲁肽与其他GLP1Ra（此处指GLP1Ra和GLP1/GIP Ra）的亚组比较。敏感性分析包括主要结果的验证性分析、偏倚处理亚组分析、留一法分析和时间累积荟萃分析。使用类似试验序贯分析的框架评估证据充分性。进行荟萃回归分析以探讨患者和试验相关特征对AF的影响。并相应讨论了现有的基础和转化证据。主要分析未显示GLP1Ra治疗降低AF/AFL风险（RR 0.69，95% CI 0.43–1.08；p = 0.097），尽管探索性排除HFpEF试验后揭示了与较低AF/AFl风险相关的假设生成性关联（RR 0.52，95% CI 0.29–0.94；p = 0.034）。有趣的是，与其他GLP1Ra相比，反复出现支持司美格鲁肽的稳健但探索性的假设生成信号（RR 0.41，95% CI 0.19–0.85；p = 0.024；交互作用p = 0.003），而其他肠促胰岛素激动剂表现出中性效应（RR 1.34，95% CI 0.74–2.41；p = 0.29）。相反，SGLT2i未显示获益证据（RR 1.11，95% CI 0.88–1.42；p = 0.28），但相应结果似乎受到显著发表偏倚的影响。GLP1Ra与SGLT2i之间的亚组差异具有统计学显著性（p = 0.035），尽管是探索性的。敏感性分析大体一致，并提示司美格鲁肽相关信号不太可能由模型依赖性假设、大型试验效应、终点确定方法或HFpEF人群的纳入所驱动。试验序贯分析表明，在得出明确结论之前需要额外的随机对照试验。当前的随机证据并未确定在无糖尿病的超重或肥胖个体中降低AF/AFL风险。然而，探索性分析发现了一个假设生成信号，提示GLP1Ra在无HFpEF人群中可能具有保护作用。在GLP-1RA中，敏感性分析进一步支持司美格鲁肽与较低AF/AFL风险之间存在稳健的、假设生成性关联，独立于人群特征或大型试验效应。反复出现支持GLP1Ra的类别间差异，尽管其假设生成价值因SGLT2i证据的不确定性而受限。尽管得到多项敏感性分析的支持，这些发现仍属探索性和假设生成性，因此需要在具有预设心律失常终点的专门随机试验中确认。

title: Personalized deep learning for short-term forecasting of impending atrial fibrillation from continuous wearable ECG signals
summary: Abstract Continuous wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring is increasingly used for ambulatory arrhythmia surveillance, yet forecasting impending atrial fibrillation (AF) remains challenging because of inter-patient ECG variability. We investigated whether personalizing a global model by fine-tuning it on an individual’s ECG improves short-term AF forecasting. A global model trained on ICENTIA11K was compared with personalized models fine-tuned across three cohorts (ICENTIA11K, IRIDIA-AF, and MobiCARE), using 60-second ECG segments and a five-minute forecast horizon. We assessed how the amount of adaptation data affected performance and analyzed ECG features such as heart rate and RMSSD. Personalized models significantly outperformed the global model, with AUROCs of 0.711 vs. 0.614 (ICENTIA11K) and 0.686 vs. 0.585 (MobiCARE), and the benefits grew with more patient-specific fine-tuning data. While the global model’s accuracy rose as AF onset approached, personalized models in the two external cohorts showed distinct temporal dynamics, suggesting that they captured patient-specific cues less dependent on onset proximity. Pre-AF episodes showed elevated heart rate and RMSSD, and feature attributions highlighted clinically relevant precursors, including frequent premature atrial complexes (PACs) and short supraventricular tachycardias (SVTs). Adapting deep learning models with patient-specific wearable ECG data significantly enhances short-term AF forecasting, supporting timely preventive intervention and improved AF management in ambulatory monitoring.

AI.tldr: 在可穿戴心电数据上对全局深度学习模型进行个体化微调，可显著提升5分钟内房颤发作的预测性能，AUROC从0.585-0.614提高至0.686-0.711。
AI.motivation: 连续可穿戴心电监测广泛用于门诊心律失常筛查，但受患者间心电变异影响，短期房颤发作预测仍具挑战。既往全局模型未充分利用个体数据，个体化微调能否改善预测尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究比较基于ICENTIA11K训练的全局模型与在三个队列（ICENTIA11K、IRIDIA-AF、MobiCARE）上个体化微调的模型。使用60秒心电片段，预测未来5分钟房颤发作。评估适应数据量对性能的影响，并分析心率和RMSSD等特征。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 个体化模型显著优于全局模型：ICENTIA11K队列AUROC 0.711 vs. 0.614，MobiCARE队列0.686 vs. 0.585；微调数据越多获益越大。全局模型准确率随房颤发作临近而升高，而两个外部队列的个体化模型呈现不同时间动态。房颤前发作显示心率和RMSSD升高，特征归因提示频发房性早搏和短阵室上性心动过速等临床相关前兆。
AI.conclusion: 利用患者个体化可穿戴心电数据微调深度学习模型可显著增强短期房颤预测，支持及时预防干预和改善门诊房颤管理。但研究为回顾性多队列分析，统计细节未报告，临床转化需前瞻性验证。

summary_zh: 摘要 连续可穿戴心电图（ECG）监测越来越多地用于动态心律失常监测，然而由于患者间ECG变异性，预测即将发生的心房颤动（AF）仍具有挑战性。我们研究了通过在个体ECG上微调全局模型进行个性化是否可改善短期AF预测。将在ICENTIA11K上训练的全局模型与在三个队列（ICENTIA11K、IRIDIA-AF和MobiCARE）中微调的个性化模型进行比较，使用60秒ECG片段和五分钟预测时间窗。我们评估了适应数据量对性能的影响，并分析了心率和RMSSD等ECG特征。个性化模型显著优于全局模型，AUROC分别为0.711 vs. 0.614（ICENTIA11K）和0.686 vs. 0.585（MobiCARE），且随着更多患者特异性微调数据，获益增加。虽然全局模型的准确性随着AF发作临近而上升，但两个外部队列中的个性化模型显示出不同的时间动态，表明它们捕获了较少依赖发作临近的患者特异性线索。AF前发作显示心率和RMSSD升高，特征归因突出了临床相关前兆，包括频发房性期前复合波（PACs）和短阵室上性心动过速（SVTs）。使用患者特异性可穿戴ECG数据调整深度学习模型显著增强了短期AF预测，支持及时预防性干预和改善动态监测中的AF管理。

title: Left Atrial Diameter Index Predicts Cerebrovascular Events after Postoperative Atrial Fibrillation following Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
summary: Objective Postoperative atrial fibrillation (POAF) is a frequent complication after coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and is linked to increased short- and long-term stroke risk. This study evaluated the prognostic value of the left atrial diameter index (LADI) for predicting cerebrovascular events (CVE) in patients undergoing isolated CABG who developed POAF, had no prior atrial fibrillation (AF), and were discharged in sinus rhythm.Materials and methods Among 2,094 patients undergoing isolated CABG between June 2015 and June 2022, 392 consecutive patients with POAF and discharge in sinus rhythm met inclusion criteria. LADI was calculated preoperatively, and an optimal cutoff (21.2 mm/m2) was determined via receiver operating characteristic curve and Youden index. Patients were classified as low (≤21.2 mm/m2) or high (>21.2 mm/m2) LADI. The association between LADI and CVE was assessed over a mean follow-up of 42.4 ± 20.0 months using Cox proportional hazards modeling.Results Thirty patients (7.7%) experienced a CVE, including eight in-hospital cases (2.0%). CVE incidence was higher in the high LADI group compared with the low LADI group (19.8 vs. 2.8%). Multivariable analysis identified older age, hypertension, congestive heart failure, and high LADI as independent CVE predictors. Kaplan-Meier analysis confirmed significantly higher CVE rates in the high LADI group (log-rank, p < 0.001).Conclusion In patients developing POAF after isolated CABG, LADI is a simple, easily obtainable parameter that independently predicts long-term CVE risk and may aid in postoperative risk stratification.

AI.tldr: 在单纯CABG术后发生POAF且出院时为窦律的患者中，术前左房内径指数（LADI）>21.2 mm/m²可独立预测远期脑血管事件，发生率19.8%对2.8%。
AI.motivation: POAF是CABG术后常见并发症，与短期和长期卒中风险升高相关；对于术后发生POAF但出院时已恢复窦律、既往无房颤的患者，如何识别远期脑血管事件（CVE）高危人群尚缺乏简便可靠的指标，本研究评估术前LADI的预后价值。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究。2015年6月至2022年6月共2094例单纯CABG患者，纳入392例连续发生POAF且出院时为窦律、既往无房颤者。术前计算LADI，经ROC曲线及Youden指数确定最佳截断值21.2 mm/m²，分为低LADI组（≤21.2）与高LADI组（>21.2）。平均随访42.4±20.0个月，以CVE为终点，采用Cox比例风险模型分析LADI与CVE的关联。
AI.result: 30例（7.7%）发生CVE，其中院内8例（2.0%）。高LADI组CVE发生率高于低LADI组（19.8% vs 2.8%）。多因素分析显示高龄、高血压、充血性心力衰竭和高LADI为CVE独立预测因素。Kaplan-Meier分析证实高LADI组CVE累积发生率显著更高（log-rank P<0.001）。摘要未报告各独立预测因素的HR及95%CI。
AI.conclusion: 对于单纯CABG术后发生POAF的患者，术前LADI是简便易得的参数，可独立预测远期CVE风险，有助于术后风险分层。本研究为单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限，LADI截断值需外部验证；摘要未报告效应量，尚不能据此确定监测或抗凝干预策略。

summary_zh:
目的：术后心房颤动（POAF）是冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后常见的并发症，并与增加的短期和长期卒中风险相关。本研究评估了左心房内径指数（LADI）对接受单纯CABG、发生POAF、既往无心房颤动（AF）且出院时维持窦性心律的患者中预测脑血管事件（CVE）的预后价值。

材料与方法：在2015年6月至2022年6月期间接受单纯CABG的2,094例患者中，392例连续发生POAF且出院时维持窦性心律的患者符合纳入标准。术前计算LADI，并通过受试者工作特征曲线和约登指数确定最佳截断值（21.2 mm/m2）。患者被分为低LADI组（≤21.2 mm/m2）或高LADI组（>21.2 mm/m2）。在平均42.4 ± 20.0个月的随访期间，使用Cox比例风险模型评估LADI与CVE之间的关联。

结果：30例患者（7.7%）发生CVE，包括8例院内事件（2.0%）。高LADI组的CVE发生率高于低LADI组（19.8 vs. 2.8%）。多变量分析确定高龄、高血压、充血性心力衰竭和高LADI为独立的CVE预测因素。Kaplan-Meier分析证实高LADI组的CVE发生率显著更高（log-rank，p < 0.001）。

结论：在单纯CABG后发生POAF的患者中，LADI是一个简单、易于获取的参数，可独立预测长期CVE风险，并可能有助于术后风险分层。

title: Multimodal Characterization of Atrial Fibrillation: From Patient-Specific Anatomy and Electrophysiology to Standardized Atrial Mapping.
summary: This narrative review synthesizes a comprehensive multimodal characterization framework for atrial fibrillation (AF), tracing its progression from patient-specific anatomical reconstruction to electrophysiological phenotyping and standardized spatial mapping. The literature was identified through searches of PubMed, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, covering publications from January 2010 to June 2026, with additional studies identified from relevant references. Anatomical characterization leverages clinical imaging modalities alongside advanced deep learning models to execute precise whole-chamber, subregional, and tissue-level modeling. Electrophysiological profiling spans multi-scale modalities, including 12-lead electrocardiography (ECG), body surface potential mapping (BSPM), electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI), and electroanatomical mapping (EAM), complemented by wearable sensors for longitudinal rhythm surveillance. To bridge heterogeneous datasets across subjects and modalities, standardized coordinate systems and multimodal registration enable reproducible data integration. These integrated data parameterize patient-specific computational models to advance mechanistic insight, risk stratification, and personalized AF management. However, broad clinical translation remains constrained by imaging variability, reconstruction noise, registration uncertainty, and limited prospective multicenter validation. Future progress hinges on moving beyond technical accuracy toward prospective trials evaluating algorithm-guided clinical utility.

AI.tldr: 本叙述性综述提出整合影像解剖、多模态电生理与标准化空间映射的房颤多模态表征框架，但临床转化仍受限于验证不足。
AI.motivation: 房颤机制复杂且患者间异质性大，既往单一模态评估难以全面刻画心房结构与电生理特征，缺乏可重复整合多源数据的标准化框架。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，检索PubMed、Web of Science和Google Scholar 2010年1月至2026年6月文献并补充参考文献；整合影像与深度学习建模、12导联ECG、BSPM、ECGI、EAM及可穿戴传感器数据，通过标准化坐标系和多模态配准实现数据整合并参数化患者特异性计算模型。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量研究结果或效应量；作者指出影像变异性、重建噪声、配准不确定性和缺乏前瞻性多中心验证是临床转化的主要限制。
AI.conclusion: 多模态整合框架有望推进房颤机制认识、风险分层和个体化管理，但未来需从技术准确性转向前瞻性试验验证算法引导的临床效用。

summary_zh: 本叙述性综述综合了一个全面的心房颤动（AF）多模态表征框架，追溯了其从患者特异性解剖重建到电生理表型分析及标准化空间标测的进展。文献通过检索PubMed、Web of Science和Google Scholar确定，覆盖2010年1月至2026年6月的出版物，并从相关参考文献中补充了额外研究。解剖表征利用临床影像模态与先进深度学习模型，执行精确的全心房、亚区域和组织水平建模。电生理分析涵盖多尺度模态，包括12导联心电图（ECG）、体表电位标测（BSPM）、心电成像（ECGI）和电解剖标测（EAM），并辅以可穿戴传感器进行纵向节律监测。为桥接跨受试者和模态的异质数据集，标准化坐标系统和多模态配准实现了可重复的数据整合。这些整合数据参数化患者特异性计算模型，以推进机制洞察、风险分层和个性化AF管理。然而，广泛的临床转化仍受限于成像变异性、重建噪声、配准不确定性和有限的前瞻性多中心验证。未来进展取决于超越技术准确性，转向评估算法引导临床效用的前瞻性试验。

title: Antidepressant use and the risk of atrial fibrillation and ventricular arrhythmia: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Antidepressants (ADs) have been associated with adverse cardiovascular effects, including cardiac arrhythmias. Evidence on the association between AD use and the risk of atrial fibrillation (AF) and ventricular arrhythmia/sudden cardiac death (VA/SCD) remains inconsistent. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the relationship between AD use and the risk of AF and VA/SCD.

METHODS: A detailed search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science till June 2026. Cohort and case-control studies comparing AD users with non-users and reporting AF, VA, or SCD as outcomes were included. Pooled odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using a random-effects model.

RESULTS: Twelve studies with 9,619,278 participants were included. AD use was associated with a significantly increased risk of VA/SCD (9 studies, 6,373,522 participants, OR = 1.34, 95% CI: 1.15-1.55; I² = 90.5%). The association remained significant for both SSRIs and TCAs. For AF, no overall significant association emerged (3 Studies, 3,245,756 participants, OR = 1.75, 95% CI: 0.84-3.62; I² = 98.1%). However, sensitivity analysis excluding one influential study showed a significant association with AF (2 Studies, 18,109 participants, OR = 1.27, 95% CI: 1.07-1.50) and eliminated heterogeneity (I² = 0%).

CONCLUSION: This meta-analysis suggests an association between AD use and an increased risk of VA/SCD, while evidence for AF remains uncertain because the results were influenced by a single study. Future large observational studies that better address confounding by indication and adequately adjust for depression are needed to provide more robust evidence.

AI.tldr: 抗抑郁药使用与室性心律失常/心脏性猝死风险增加相关（OR=1.34），但与房颤的关联因研究间异质性高而不确定。
AI.motivation: 抗抑郁药已知有心血管不良反应，但其与房颤及室性心律失常/心脏性猝死风险的关系既往证据不一致，需系统评价明确。
AI.method: 系统综述与荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science截至2026年6月，纳入比较抗抑郁药使用者与非使用者的队列和病例对照研究，终点为房颤、室性心律失常或心脏性猝死，采用随机效应模型计算合并OR及95%CI。
AI.result: 共纳入12项研究、9,619,278名参与者。抗抑郁药使用与VA/SCD风险显著增加相关（9项研究，6,373,522人，OR=1.34，95%CI 1.15-1.55；I²=90.5%），SSRIs和TCAs均显著。房颤总体无显著关联（3项研究，3,245,756人，OR=1.75，95%CI 0.84-3.62；I²=98.1%），但排除一项影响性研究后，房颤关联显著（2项研究，18,109人，OR=1.27，95%CI 1.07-1.50）且异质性消失（I²=0%）。
AI.conclusion: 抗抑郁药使用与VA/SCD风险增加相关，房颤证据因单研究影响而不确定；需大型观察性研究更好控制适应证混杂和抑郁调整，以提供更可靠证据。

summary_zh:
背景：抗抑郁药（ADs）与包括心律失常在内的不良心血管效应相关。关于AD使用与心房颤动（AF）及室性心律失常/心脏性猝死（VA/SCD）风险之间关联的证据仍不一致。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在评估AD使用与AF及VA/SCD风险之间的关系。

方法：在PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science中进行了详细检索，截止至2026年6月。纳入比较AD使用者与非使用者，并报告AF、VA或SCD作为结局的队列研究和病例对照研究。使用随机效应模型计算合并比值比（OR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。

结果：共纳入12项研究，包含9,619,278名参与者。AD使用与VA/SCD风险显著增加相关（9项研究，6,373,522名参与者，OR = 1.34，95% CI：1.15-1.55；I² = 90.5%）。该关联在SSRIs和TCAs中均保持显著。对于AF，未出现总体显著关联（3项研究，3,245,756名参与者，OR = 1.75，95% CI：0.84-3.62；I² = 98.1%）。然而，排除一项有影响力研究的敏感性分析显示与AF存在显著关联（2项研究，18,109名参与者，OR = 1.27，95% CI：1.07-1.50），并消除了异质性（I² = 0%）。

结论：本荟萃分析提示AD使用与VA/SCD风险增加之间存在关联，而AF的证据仍不确定，因为结果受到单项研究的影响。未来需要更大规模的观察性研究，更好地处理适应证混杂并充分调整抑郁因素，以提供更可靠的证据。

title: Atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter in China: trends and projections to 2050 from GBD 2023.
summary: Atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter (AF/AFL) impose a mounting health burden worldwide, yet no comprehensive study has systematically evaluated their long‑term trajectories and future scenarios for China using the latest Global Burden of Disease (GBD) data. Using the GBD 2023 dataset, we extracted age- and sex-specific burden estimates of AF/AFL for China (1990-2023). Joinpoint regression, age-period-cohort modeling, decomposition analysis, frontier analysis, and autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) forecasting were applied to characterize historical dynamics and future trajectories. In 2023, China had 12.39 million prevalent cases, 1.06 million incident cases, 65,008 deaths, and 1.75 million disability‑adjusted life years (DALYs). Males had higher age‑standardized prevalence rate (ASPR) (614.89 vs. 472.17) and age‑standardized incidence rate (ASIR) (49.22 vs. 43.00), while females had higher age‑standardized mortality rate (ASMR) (3.69 vs. 2.52) per 100,000. The age‑standardized DALY rate (ASDR) was slightly higher in males (79.24) than in females (77.34) per 100,000. The mortality rate, which fell substantially during 1998-2004 (annual percentage change [APC]: - 5.46; 95% confidence interval [CI]: - 6.28 to - 4.64), unexpectedly reversed to a sharp rise after 2020 (APC: 3.91; 95% CI: 2.23 to 5.62). Decomposition analysis identified population aging and demographic growth as the predominant drivers of the increasing burden. Frontier analysis revealed a persistent gap between observed burden and achievable benchmarks. ARIMA models project the burden will remain substantial through 2050, with sustained nonfatal morbidity. China's AF/AFL burden more than doubled from 1990 to 2023, driven by aging and population growth. The post-2020 mortality reversal and persistently high nonfatal burden highlight the urgent need for age- and sex-tailored prevention, early detection, and enhanced chronic care strategies.

AI.tldr: 中国AF/AFL负担1990-2023年翻倍，2020年后死亡率意外转升，预测至2050年非致死性负担持续高企。
AI.motivation: AF/AFL全球健康负担加重，但缺乏基于最新GBD数据对中国长期趋势和未来情景的系统评估。
AI.method: 基于GBD 2023数据，提取中国1990-2023年AF/AFL年龄和性别别负担估计，采用Joinpoint回归、年龄-时期-队列模型、分解分析、前沿分析和ARIMA预测模型分析历史动态和未来轨迹。
AI.result: 2023年中国有1239万患病、106万发病、65008例死亡和175万DALYs；男性年龄标化患病率（614.89 vs 472.17/10万）和发病率（49.22 vs 43.00/10万）更高，女性年龄标化死亡率更高（3.69 vs 2.52/10万）；年龄标化DALY率男性略高（79.24 vs 77.34/10万）。死亡率在1998-2004年显著下降（APC -5.46, 95%CI -6.28至-4.64），但2020年后急剧上升（APC 3.91, 95%CI 2.23至5.62）。分解分析显示人口老龄化和人口增长是主要驱动因素。前沿分析显示观察负担与可实现基准之间存在持续差距。ARIMA模型预测至2050年负担仍将沉重，非致死性发病率持续。
AI.conclusion: 中国AF/AFL负担从1990年到2023年翻倍以上，由老龄化和人口增长驱动；2020年后死亡率逆转和持续高非致死性负担提示需 urgent 采取年龄和性别量身定制的预防、早期检测和加强慢性护理策略。

summary_zh: 心房颤动和心房扑动（AF/AFL）在全球范围内造成了日益加重的健康负担，然而尚无综合研究利用最新的全球疾病负担（GBD）数据系统评估中国的长期轨迹和未来情景。利用GBD 2023数据集，我们提取了中国（1990-2023年）AF/AFL的年龄和性别特异性负担估计值。应用Joinpoint回归、年龄-时期-队列模型、分解分析、前沿分析和自回归积分滑动平均（ARIMA）预测来刻画历史动态和未来轨迹。2023年，中国有1239万患病病例、106万发病病例、65,008例死亡和175万伤残调整生命年（DALYs）。男性年龄标化患病率（ASPR）（614.89 vs. 472.17）和年龄标化发病率（ASIR）（49.22 vs. 43.00）较高，而女性年龄标化死亡率（ASMR）较高（每10万3.69 vs. 2.52）。男性年龄标化DALY率（ASDR）略高于女性（每10万79.24 vs. 77.34）。死亡率在1998-2004年期间大幅下降（年度百分比变化[APC]：-5.46；95%置信区间[CI]：-6.28至-4.64），但2020年后意外逆转为急剧上升（APC：3.91；95% CI：2.23至5.62）。分解分析确定人口老龄化和人口增长是负担增加的主要驱动因素。前沿分析揭示了观察到的负担与可实现基准之间的持续差距。ARIMA模型预测负担将持续至2050年，非致死性发病率持续存在。中国的AF/AFL负担从1990年到2023年增加了一倍多，由老龄化和人口增长驱动。2020年后的死亡率逆转和持续高的非致死性负担突显了迫切需要针对年龄和性别的预防、早期检测和加强慢性护理策略。

title: Correlation of QT Dispersion in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction and Reperfusion Arrhythmias Following Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Prospective Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Reperfusion arrhythmias are commonly encountered following primary percutaneous coronary intervention (PPCI) in patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI). QT dispersion (QTd) and corrected QTd (cQTd) are noninvasive electrocardiographic markers reflecting heterogeneity of ventricular repolarization and may serve as predictors of electrical instability and arrhythmic risk following reperfusion.

OBJECTIVES: The objective of this study was to evaluate the association between QTd and reperfusion arrhythmias following PPCI in patients with AMI, and to assess the temporal changes in QTd and cQTd after reperfusion.

MATERIALS AND METHODS: This prospective observational study included 125 patients with AMI undergoing PPCI. Standard 12-lead electrocardiograms were recorded at admission, immediately after PPCI, and at discharge for measurement of QTd and cQTd. Continuous Holter monitoring was used to identify reperfusion arrhythmias, which were categorized as major or minor arrhythmias. Clinical, electrocardiographic, and angiographic parameters were analyzed for association with QTd and cQTd values.

RESULTS: Frequent premature ventricular complexes were the most common reperfusion arrhythmia (44.8%), followed by accelerated idioventricular rhythm (15.2%) and nonsustained ventricular tachycardia (12.8%). Receiver-operating characteristic curve analysis revealed that corrected QTd at discharge had moderate predictive ability for major reperfusion arrhythmias with an area under the curve of 0.648. A cutoff value of 69.49 ms yielded a sensitivity of 43.5% and specificity of 87.3% for predicting major arrhythmias. Both QTd and cQTd demonstrated a progressive decline from admission to discharge following PPCI. Mean cQTd decreased from 114.09 ms at admission to 80.52 ms post-PPCI and 58.18 ms at discharge. Patients with major reperfusion arrhythmias had significantly higher cQTd values at admission (130.76 ± 41.64 ms vs 110.33 ± 24.18 ms; P = 0.032), post-PPCI (93.75 ± 29.59 ms vs 77.50 ± 16.94 ms; P = 0.0175), and discharge (66.62 ± 18.89 ms vs. 56.27 ± 11.30 ms; P = 0.018) compared to patients with minor arrhythmias. Increasing Killip class was associated with progressively higher discharge cQTd values. Smokers also demonstrated significantly higher discharge cQTd values compared to nonsmokers (P = 0.0061).

CONCLUSION: QTd and corrected QTd significantly decrease following successful reperfusion with PPCI. Elevated cQTd values were associated with major reperfusion arrhythmias, suggesting that cQTd may serve as a useful noninvasive marker for predicting arrhythmic risk following PPCI in AMI patients. Increased cQTd was also associated with greater clinical severity as reflected by higher Killip class.

AI.tldr: 在125例急性心梗行直接PCI患者中，校正QT离散度（cQTd）随再灌注逐步下降，且发生主要再灌注心律失常者各时间点cQTd均更高，提示其可作为预测再灌注后心律失常风险的无创指标。
AI.motivation: 再灌注心律失常是急性心肌梗死患者直接PCI后常见并发症，而QT离散度（QTd）和校正QTd（cQTd）作为反映心室复极异质性的无创心电图指标，能否预测再灌注后心律失常风险尚不明确，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 前瞻性观察性研究，纳入125例接受直接PCI的急性心肌梗死患者。于入院时、PCI后即刻及出院时记录标准12导联心电图测量QTd和cQTd，并采用连续Holter监测识别再灌注心律失常（分为主要和次要心律失常）。分析临床、心电图及血管造影参数与QTd/cQTd的关联，采用ROC曲线评估预测价值。
AI.result: 再灌注心律失常以频发室性早搏最常见（44.8%），其次为加速性室性自主心律（15.2%）和非持续性室性心动过速（12.8%）。出院时cQTd预测主要再灌注心律失常的ROC曲线下面积为0.648，切点69.49 ms时敏感度43.5%、特异度87.3%。cQTd均值从入院时114.09 ms降至PCI后80.52 ms、出院时58.18 ms。发生主要心律失常者入院时（130.76±41.64 ms vs 110.33±24.18 ms，P=0.032）、PCI后（93.75±29.59 ms vs 77.50±16.94 ms，P=0.0175）及出院时（66.62±18.89 ms vs 56.27±11.30 ms，P=0.018）cQTd均显著高于次要心律失常者。Killip分级越高，出院时cQTd越高；吸烟者出院时cQTd显著高于非吸烟者（P=0.0061）。
AI.conclusion: 直接PCI成功再灌注后QTd和cQTd显著下降；cQTd升高与主要再灌注心律失常相关，提示cQTd可作为预测急性心梗患者PCI后心律失常风险的无创标志物，且与Killip分级反映的临床严重程度相关。但预测能力仅为中等（AUC 0.648），敏感度偏低，尚需更大样本验证其临床实用性。

summary_zh:
背景：再灌注心律失常在急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者接受直接经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PPCI）后常见。QT离散度（QTd）和校正QTd（cQTd）是无创心电图标志物，反映心室复极异质性，可能作为再灌注后电不稳定和心律失常风险的预测指标。

目的：本研究旨在评估AMI患者PPCI后QTd与再灌注心律失常之间的关联，并评估再灌注后QTd和cQTd的时间变化。

材料与方法：这项前瞻性观察性研究纳入125例接受PPCI的AMI患者。在入院时、PPCI后即刻和出院时记录标准12导联心电图，用于测量QTd和cQTd。使用连续Holter监测识别再灌注心律失常，将其分为主要或次要心律失常。分析临床、心电图和血管造影参数与QTd和cQTd值的关联。

结果：频发室性早搏是最常见的再灌注心律失常（44.8%），其次是加速性室性自主心律（15.2%）和非持续性室性心动过速（12.8%）。受试者工作特征曲线分析显示，出院时校正QTd对主要再灌注心律失常具有中等预测能力，曲线下面积为0.648。 cutoff值为69.49 ms时，预测主要心律失常的敏感性为43.5%，特异性为87.3%。PPCI后，QTd和cQTd从入院到出院均呈现逐步下降。平均cQTd从入院时的114.09 ms降至PPCI后的80.52 ms和出院时的58.18 ms。与次要心律失常患者相比，主要再灌注心律失常患者在入院时（130.76 ± 41.64 ms vs 110.33 ± 24.18 ms；P = 0.032）、PPCI后（93.75 ± 29.59 ms vs 77.50 ± 16.94 ms；P = 0.0175）和出院时（66.62 ± 18.89 ms vs. 56.27 ± 11.30 ms；P = 0.018）的cQTd值显著更高。Killip分级增加与出院时cQTd值逐步升高相关。与不吸烟者相比，吸烟者的出院时cQTd值也显著更高（P = 0.0061）。

结论：PPCI成功再灌注后，QTd和校正QTd显著降低。cQTd值升高与主要再灌注心律失常相关，提示cQTd可能作为预测AMI患者PPCI后心律失常风险的有用无创标志物。cQTd增加也与更高的Killip分级所反映的临床严重程度增加相关。

title: Case Report: Brugada syndrome uncovered by delivery in a 32-year-old patient.
summary: We report a 32-year-old primigravida with no prior symptoms, normal baseline ECG, and no family history of sudden death who developed ventricular fibrillation (VF) shortly after uncomplicated vaginal delivery. She received epidural ropivacaine and sufentanil during labor. Post-resuscitation ECG demonstrated coved ST-segment elevation with T-wave inversion in V1-V2, consistent with spontaneous type 1 Brugada syndrome (BrS) pattern. Echocardiography excluded structural heart disease; coronary CT angiography excluded coronary artery disease. Laboratory investigations revealed borderline hypokalemia (3.5 mmol/L) and mild hypomagnesemia (0.75 mmol/L). Clinical whole-exome sequencing revealed no pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in established arrhythmia-associated genes. The ECG normalized two days later. An implantable cardioverter-defibrillator was implanted. This case illustrates multifactorial unmasking of latent BrS-involving ropivacaine-mediated sodium channel blockade, postpartum autonomic instability, bradycardia, and electrolyte imbalance in a genotype-negative asymptomatic woman, highlighting the importance of recognizing concealed channelopathies in peripartum cardiac arrest.

AI.tldr: 32岁初产妇无既往症状、基线心电图正常，阴道分娩后发生室颤，复苏后心电图呈1型Brugada波，基因检测阴性，植入ICD。
AI.motivation: Brugada综合征（BrS）在无症状、基线心电图正常且无家族史的患者中诊断困难，围产期心脏骤停的病因常被忽视，需提高对隐匿性离子通道病的识别。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为32岁初产妇，无既往症状、基线心电图正常、无猝死家族史；分娩时接受硬膜外罗哌卡因和舒芬太尼镇痛。报告其临床过程、复苏后心电图、超声心动图、冠状动脉CT血管造影、实验室检查及临床全外显子测序结果。
AI.result: 患者阴道分娩后不久发生室颤，复苏后心电图V1-V2导联呈穹隆型ST段抬高伴T波倒置，符合自发1型BrS模式；超声心动图排除结构性心脏病，冠状动脉CT血管造影排除冠心病；实验室检查示边缘性低钾血症（3.5 mmol/L）和轻度低镁血症（0.75 mmol/L）；临床全外显子测序未发现已知心律失常相关基因的致病或可能致病变异；心电图两天后恢复正常；植入ICD。
AI.conclusion: 本例提示罗哌卡因介导的钠通道阻滞、产后自主神经不稳定、心动过缓及电解质失衡等多因素共同揭示了基因阴性的隐匿性BrS，强调围产期心脏骤停需警惕隐匿性离子通道病；局限性为单例报告，因果关系不能确定。

summary_zh: 我们报告一例32岁初孕妇，既往无症状，基线心电图正常，无猝死家族史，在顺利阴道分娩后不久发生心室颤动（VF）。她在分娩期间接受了硬膜外罗哌卡因和舒芬太尼。复苏后心电图显示V1-V2导联穹隆型ST段抬高伴T波倒置，符合自发性1型Brugada综合征（BrS）模式。超声心动图排除了结构性心脏病；冠状动脉CT血管造影排除了冠状动脉疾病。实验室检查显示边缘性低钾血症（3.5 mmol/L）和轻度低镁血症（0.75 mmol/L）。临床全外显子组测序未在已知心律失常相关基因中发现致病性或可能致病性变异。两天后心电图恢复正常。植入了植入式心律转复除颤器。本病例说明，在一名基因型阴性、无症状的女性中，潜伏性BrS的多因素揭露涉及罗哌卡因介导的钠通道阻滞、产后自主神经不稳定、心动过缓和电解质失衡，强调了在围产期心脏骤停中识别隐匿性离子通道病的重要性。

title: Post-induction residual time: a novel sensing phenomenon during induced ventricular fibrillation in subcutaneous ICD recipients
summary: Background Subcutaneous implantable cardioverter defibrillators (S-ICD) are extensively used in the primary and secondary prevention of sudden cardiac death. Ventricular fibrillation (VF) induction during implantation remains standard to confirm device functionality.Objective To compare electrocardiographic (ECG) and technical variables between induced and spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias in S-ICD recipients.Methods A retrospective observational study was performed on 10 consecutive patients with S-ICD. Variables included episode duration, sensing time, charge time, and shock impedance. For each patient, the implant induced VF episode was compared to at least one spontaneous event during follow-up.Results The mean age was 36.4 years (range: 22-61); 2 patients were male. All patients received intermuscular S-ICD implants, with the lead placed in the left parasternal position in 7 patients and right parasternal in 3. Episode duration and sensing time were consistently shorter in spontaneous events, and shock impedance was lower. Charge time, however, was longer in spontaneous events (by 1.4 to 1.8 s).Conclusions In this case series, spontaneous ventricular arrhythmic events in S-ICD patients demonstrated shorter sensing and therapy delivery times compared with induced ventricular fibrillation episodes. A measurable Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) was identified in all induced episodes and was absent during spontaneous ventricular arrhythmias, suggesting that 50-Hz-induced VF may not fully reproduce spontaneous arrhythmic events from the perspective of device sensing performance. These findings support the hypothesis that part of the delay observed during implant testing may be related to the induction process itself rather than to the intrinsic sensing capabilities of the S-ICD. Further studies are warranted to confirm these observations and to evaluate alternative VF induction strategies in future device platforms. Future integration of S-ICD systems with leadless pacing technologies may provide alternative ventricular fibrillation induction strategies, including T-wave shock delivery during either sensed intrinsic rhythm or leadless-paced rhythm. Such approaches could potentially avoid the occurrence of Post-Induction Residual Time (PRT) and may provide a model that more closely reproduces spontaneous ventricular fibrillation than current 50-Hz induction techniques.

AI.tldr: 在S-ICD患者中，自发室性心律失常的感知与治疗发放时间均短于50 Hz诱发的室颤，提示诱发过程本身存在可测量的诱后残余时间（PRT）。
AI.motivation: S-ICD植入时常规以50 Hz诱发室颤验证设备功能，但诱发室颤能否真实反映自发心律失常下的感知性能尚不明确，既往缺乏同一患者内诱发与自发事件的直接比较。
AI.method: 回顾性观察研究，连续纳入10例S-ICD患者（平均年龄36.4岁，范围22-61岁，男性2例；7例左胸骨旁、3例右胸骨旁导线，均为肌间植入）。比较每例患者植入时诱发的室颤事件与随访中至少1次自发事件，指标包括事件持续时间、感知时间、充电时间与除颤阻抗；摘要未报告具体统计方法与样本量估算。
AI.result: 自发事件的事件持续时间与感知时间均一致短于诱发事件，除颤阻抗更低；充电时间在自发事件中反而更长，延长1.4-1.8 s。所有诱发事件中均可测得PRT，而自发室性心律失常中PRT缺失；摘要未报告各指标的具体数值、95%CI或P值。
AI.conclusion: 50 Hz诱发室颤可能无法完全复现自发心律失常下的设备感知表现，植入测试中的部分延迟或源于诱发过程本身而非S-ICD固有感知能力。该结果来自10例小样本病例系列，需进一步研究验证，并探索无导线起搏配合T波电击等替代诱发策略以消除PRT。

summary_zh:
背景：皮下植入式心律转复除颤器（S-ICD）广泛用于心脏性猝死的一级和二级预防。植入过程中诱发性心室颤动（VF）仍是确认设备功能的标准方法。

目的：比较S-ICD患者中诱发性与自发性室性心律失常的心电图（ECG）和技术变量。

方法：对10例连续S-ICD患者进行回顾性观察性研究。变量包括发作持续时间、感知时间、充电时间和除颤阻抗。对于每位患者，将植入时诱发的VF发作与随访期间至少一次自发性事件进行比较。

结果：平均年龄为36.4岁（范围：22-61）；2例患者为男性。所有患者均接受了肌间S-ICD植入，其中7例导线置于左胸骨旁位置，3例置于右胸骨旁位置。自发性事件的发作持续时间和感知时间 consistently 较短，除颤阻抗较低。然而，自发性事件的充电时间较长（延长1.4至1.8秒）。

结论：在本病例系列中，S-ICD患者的自发性室性心律失常事件与诱发性心室颤动发作相比，表现出更短的感知和治疗 delivery 时间。在所有诱发性发作中均识别出可测量的诱导后残余时间（PRT），而在自发性室性心律失常期间不存在，这表明从设备感知性能的角度来看，50-Hz诱发的VF可能无法完全再现自发性心律失常事件。这些发现支持以下假设：植入测试期间观察到的部分延迟可能与诱导过程本身有关，而非S-ICD的固有感知能力。需要进一步研究以确认这些观察结果，并在未来设备平台中评估替代的VF诱导策略。未来S-ICD系统与无导线起搏技术的整合可能提供替代的心室颤动诱导策略，包括在感知到的自身心律或无导线起搏心律期间进行T波电击 delivery。这些方法可能避免诱导后残余时间（PRT）的发生，并可能提供比当前50-Hz诱导技术更接近自发性心室颤动的模型。

title: Pharmacological management and outcomes of sustained ventricular tachycardia in children and adolescents: a single-center retrospective study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Evidence related to the efficacy and prognosis of pharmacologic therapy for sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) in the pediatric population remains scarce. This single-center retrospective study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic outcomes and drug sensitivity of sustained VT in children and adolescents.

METHODS: We analyzed patients hospitalized due to sustained VT at the Department of Pediatric Cardiology, Shengjing Hospital of China Medical University, between February 2018 and September 2025. Patients were prescribed antiarrhythmic drugs according to electrocardiogram (ECG) morphology. Electrocardiographic and echocardiographic data, cardioversion success rate, and adverse events were recorded. Following VT termination, oral antiarrhythmic drugs were initiated for VT prevention.

RESULTS: In total, 29 patients (18 boys, 11 girls) were included, with a mean age of 8.3 ± 4.6 years. The patients were diagnosed with idiopathic VT (n = 25), VT associated with myocarditis (n = 3), or VT associated with structural heart disease (n = 1). According to ECG morphology, patients were classified as presumed left fascicular VT (n = 21, 72.4%), outflow tract VT (n = 2, 6.9%), polymorphic VT (n = 3, 10.3%), and other-origin VT (n = 3, 10.3%). A total of 38 sustained VT episodes occurred among these patients. Four episodes of VT terminated without antiarrhythmic intervention, while the remaining 34 episodes were successfully cardioverted under medical intervention, with monotherapy effective in 25 episodes (73.5%). Intravenous verapamil was effective for presumed left fascicular VT (success rate of 92.3%). During a mean follow-up period of 2.1 ± 1.7 years, 41.4% of the patients had complete resolution of VT with drug discontinued, while the remainders still required antiarrhythmic drugs. Drug therapy alone resulted in a higher complete resolution rate in patients with infantile onset (<1 year) compared to those with older onset (66.6% vs. 13.0%, P = 0.006). Transient, reversible cardiac dysfunction occurred in only three patients. All patients maintained cardiac function well during follow-up, and no sudden cardiac death was recorded.

CONCLUSION: Idiopathic VT is the predominant type of sustained VT in children and adolescents. In this study, the vast majority of the cases were left fascicular VT. Patients with presumed left fascicular VT exhibit sensitivity to intravenous verapamil, although clinicians must remain vigilant of transient hypotension. The long-term follow-up results revealed an overall favorable prognosis in pediatric VT.

AI.tldr: 儿童及青少年持续性室速以特发性左分支型为主，静脉维拉帕米对推测左分支型室速有效率高（92.3%），婴儿期起病者单纯药物治疗完全缓解率更高（66.6% vs 13.0%，P=0.006），整体预后良好。
AI.motivation: 儿童及青少年持续性室性心动过速（VT）的药物治疗疗效与预后证据匮乏，本研究旨在评估该人群持续性VT的治疗转归及药物敏感性。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，纳入2018年2月至2025年9月于中国医科大学附属盛京医院儿科心脏科住院的持续性VT患者29例（男18例，女11例），平均年龄8.3±4.6岁。根据心电图形态选择抗心律失常药物，记录心电图、超声心动图数据、转复成功率及不良事件；VT终止后口服抗心律失常药物预防复发。
AI.result: 29例中特发性VT 25例、心肌炎相关VT 3例、结构性心脏病相关VT 1例；按心电图形态分为推测左分支型VT 21例（72.4%）、流出道VT 2例（6.9%）、多形性VT 3例（10.3%）、其他起源VT 3例（10.3%）。共发生38次持续性VT发作，4次未干预自行终止，其余34次经药物干预成功转复，单药有效25次（73.5%）；静脉维拉帕米对推测左分支型VT有效率为92.3%。平均随访2.1±1.7年，41.4%患者停药后VT完全缓解，其余仍需抗心律失常药物；婴儿期起病（<1岁）者单纯药物治疗完全缓解率高于年长起病者（66.6% vs 13.0%，P=0.006）。仅3例出现短暂可逆性心功能不全，随访期间所有患者心功能良好，无心脏性猝死。
AI.conclusion: 儿童及青少年持续性VT以特发性VT为主，本研究中绝大多数为左分支型VT；推测左分支型VT对静脉维拉帕米敏感，但需警惕短暂性低血压；长期随访显示儿童VT总体预后良好。本研究为单中心回顾性设计、样本量小，结论需更大规模前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh:
背景：关于儿童人群中持续性室性心动过速（VT）药物治疗疗效与预后的证据仍然很少。本单中心回顾性研究旨在评估儿童和青少年持续性VT的治疗结局及药物敏感性。

方法：我们分析了2018年2月至2025年9月期间在中国医科大学附属盛京医院小儿心脏病科因持续性VT住院的患者。根据心电图（ECG）形态学为患者处方抗心律失常药物。记录心电图和超声心动图数据、心脏电复律成功率及不良事件。VT终止后，开始口服抗心律失常药物以预防VT。

结果：共纳入29例患者（男18例，女11例），平均年龄8.3 ± 4.6岁。患者被诊断为特发性VT（n = 25）、与心肌炎相关的VT（n = 3）或与结构性心脏病相关的VT（n = 1）。根据ECG形态学，患者被分类为推测的左分支型VT（n = 21，72.4%）、流出道VT（n = 2，6.9%）、多形性VT（n = 3，10.3%）和其他起源的VT（n = 3，10.3%）。这些患者中共发生38次持续性VT发作。4次VT发作未经抗心律失常干预即终止，而其余34次发作在医疗干预下成功转复，其中单药治疗对25次发作有效（73.5%）。静脉维拉帕米对推测的左分支型VT有效（成功率为92.3%）。在平均2.1 ± 1.7年的随访期间，41.4%的患者VT完全缓解并停用药物，而其余患者仍需要抗心律失常药物。与发病年龄较大的患者相比，仅药物治疗在婴儿期起病（<1岁）患者中导致更高的完全缓解率（66.6% vs. 13.0%，P = 0.006）。仅3例患者发生短暂、可逆的心功能障碍。所有患者在随访期间心功能维持良好，未记录到心脏性猝死。

结论：特发性VT是儿童和青少年持续性VT的主要类型。在本研究中，绝大多数病例为左分支型VT。推测为左分支型VT的患者对静脉维拉帕米表现出敏感性，尽管临床医生必须警惕短暂性低血压。长期随访结果显示儿童VT总体预后良好。

title: Acute effects of physical exercise in patients with arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy harboring plakophilin-2 variants.
authors: Kyle G P J M Boyle
summary:
BACKGROUND: Despite the connection between physical exercise and arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy (ARVC), there are no data on the safety and suitability of exercise for patients.

OBJECTIVE: To quantify the incidence and complexity of premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) and cardiometabolic load during different exercises in patients with ARVC with pathogenic plakophilin-2 variants.

METHODS: 25 participants with definite ARVC (9 female and 16 male) performed different exercises while cardiorespiratory function was monitored. Resistance exercises included 2-legged squats and unilateral biceps curls, whereas endurance exercises included walking and cycling at a heart rate of 80, 100, and 120 bpm. Each activity was followed by 10 minutes of recovery.

RESULTS: PVC burden more than doubled (P < .001) during the early recovery phase than in the active exercise phases, as did the occurrence of ≥ 3 PVC morphologies (52% vs 84%, P = .03). Only unilateral biceps curls did not increase PVC burden compared with rest (P = .361). Resistance exercises combined lower cardiac load and arrhythmic burden for comparable effort levels. Exercise intensity classification showed large fluctuations, from "light" to "high intensity" for the same task, depending on the metric used.

CONCLUSIONS: Early recovery monitoring is essential to properly assess the arrhythmic burden of exercise in plakophilin-2 ARVC. Small muscle mass exercises show the lowest PVC burden and cardiac load-surrogate markers of arrhythmic risk and disease progression-and therefore offer a promising path for prescribing exercise in this population. Exercise intensity guidelines for ARVC are insufficiently clear and should be refined.

AI.tldr: 在25例携带PKP2致病变异的ARVC患者中，运动后早期恢复期室性早搏负荷较运动期翻倍，而小肌群抗阻运动（单侧肱二头肌弯举）不增加PVC负荷。
AI.motivation: 运动与致心律失常性右室心肌病（ARVC）相关，但缺乏运动安全性数据；对于携带plakophilin-2（PKP2）致病变异的确诊ARVC患者，不同运动方式及强度下室性早搏（PVC）负荷与心脏代谢负荷尚不清楚，现行运动强度指南亦不明确。
AI.method: 单中心观察性研究，纳入25例确诊ARVC且携带PKP2致病变异者（女9例、男16例），在心肺功能监测下完成不同运动：抗阻运动包括双腿深蹲和单侧肱二头肌弯举，耐力运动包括以80、100、120 bpm心率步行的步行和骑行，每项活动后恢复10分钟；比较运动期与早期恢复期的PVC负荷、≥3种PVC形态发生率及心脏代谢负荷，统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 早期恢复期PVC负荷较运动期增加逾一倍（P<.001）；≥3种PVC形态的发生率由运动期52%升至恢复期84%（P=.03）。仅单侧肱二头肌弯举未较静息增加PVC负荷（P=.361）。在同等用力水平下，抗阻运动的心脏负荷与心律失常负荷均较低。同一任务按不同指标划分的运动强度可从“低强度”波动至“高强度”。
AI.conclusion: 对PKP2相关ARVC患者，运动后早期恢复期监测对准确评估心律失常负荷至关重要；小肌群运动PVC负荷及心脏负荷替代指标最低，可能是该人群运动处方的优选方向；现有ARVC运动强度指南不够清晰，需进一步细化。本研究样本量小、为观察性设计，结论需更大样本验证。

summary_zh:
背景：尽管体力运动与致心律失常性右心室心肌病（ARVC）之间存在关联，但尚无关于运动对患者安全性和适宜性的数据。

目的：量化携带致病性plakophilin-2变异的ARVC患者在不同运动期间室性早搏（PVCs）的发生率和复杂性以及心脏代谢负荷。

方法：25名确诊ARVC的参与者（9名女性和16名男性）在监测心肺功能的同时进行不同运动。抗阻运动包括双腿深蹲和单侧肱二头肌弯举，而耐力运动包括以80、100和120次/分的心率步行和骑行。每项活动后均进行10分钟恢复。

结果：早期恢复阶段的PVC负荷比主动运动阶段增加一倍以上（P < .001），≥3种PVC形态的出现率也是如此（52% vs 84%，P = .03）。与休息相比，仅单侧肱二头肌弯举未增加PVC负荷（P = .361）。在相当的努力水平下，抗阻运动的心脏负荷和心律失常负荷均较低。运动强度分类显示出大幅波动，同一任务从“低强度”到“高强度”不等，取决于所使用的指标。

结论：早期恢复监测对于正确评估plakophilin-2 ARVC患者运动的心律失常负荷至关重要。小肌肉量运动显示出最低的PVC负荷和心脏负荷——心律失常风险和疾病进展的替代标志物——因此为在该人群中开具运动处方提供了有前景的路径。ARVC的运动强度指南不够明确，应予以完善。

title: Serum NT-proBNP Concentrations in Pediatric Patients with a History of Idiopathic Cardiac Arrhythmias: A Pilot Study
summary: Diagnosis and management of pediatric cardiac arrhythmias is challenging due to heterogeneous clinical presentation and limited availability of validated biomarkers. N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) is a well-established marker of myocardial stress; its role in pediatric arrhythmias has not been fully elucidated. This pilot study included 26 children and adolescents with a history of idiopathic ventricular arrhythmias (VAs, n = 17) or supraventricular tachycardia (SVT, n = 9) and 20 hospital-based controls without arrhythmias. Serum NT-proBNP was measured by ELISA. Group differences were tested with the Mann-Whitney U test and correlations with Spearman's coefficient. NT-proBNP concentrations were significantly higher in pediatric patients with a history of cardiac arrhythmias than in controls, with the difference remaining statistically significant for the VAs subgroup. The treated patients had significantly lower levels than the untreated individuals. NT-proBNP showed no significant associations with age, sex, echocardiography, or other laboratory parameters. In the VAs subgroup, NT-proBNP was moderately negatively correlated with baseline QRS duration. Given a limited patient population, these findings represent a pilot exploratory analysis. NT-proBNP should be considered a supportive biomarker reflecting functional myocardial strain rather than a stand-alone diagnostic tool for pediatric arrhythmia classification.

AI.tldr: 儿童特发性心律失常患者血清NT-proBNP显著高于无心律失常对照，室性心律失常亚组尤为明显，且治疗者低于未治疗者，提示其可作为反映心肌功能负荷的辅助生物标志物。
AI.motivation: 儿童心律失常临床表现异质性强，且缺乏经过验证的生物标志物，诊断与治疗决策困难。NT-proBNP是公认的心肌应力标志物，但其在儿童心律失常中的作用尚未充分阐明，本研究旨在初步探索其在该人群中的水平及与临床参数的关系。
AI.method: 单中心初步探索性研究，纳入26例有特发性室性心律失常（VAs，n=17）或室上性心动过速（SVT，n=9）病史的儿童及青少年，以及20例无心律失常的院内对照。采用ELISA法测定血清NT-proBNP，组间比较使用Mann-Whitney U检验，相关性分析使用Spearman系数。
AI.result: 心律失常组NT-proBNP显著高于对照组，VAs亚组差异仍具统计学意义；接受治疗者水平显著低于未治疗者。NT-proBNP与年龄、性别、超声心动图及其他实验室指标均无显著关联；VAs亚组中NT-proBNP与基线QRS时限呈中度负相关。摘要未报告具体浓度数值、效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: NT-proBNP在儿童心律失常中可能反映功能性心肌应力，宜作为辅助生物标志物而非独立诊断或分型工具。样本量小属初步探索性分析，结果需更大规模研究验证，尚不足以改变现有电生理临床决策。

summary_zh: 儿童心律失常的诊断和管理具有挑战性，因为临床表现异质性强且经过验证的生物标志物有限。N末端B型利钠肽原（NT-proBNP）是公认的心肌应激标志物；其在儿童心律失常中的作用尚未完全阐明。本初步研究纳入26名有特发性室性心律失常（VAs，n = 17）或室上性心动过速（SVT，n = 9）病史的儿童和青少年，以及20名无心律失常的医院对照。采用ELISA法测定血清NT-proBNP。组间差异采用Mann-Whitney U检验，相关性采用Spearman系数分析。有心脏心律失常病史的儿童患者NT-proBNP浓度显著高于对照组，且该差异在VAs亚组中仍具有统计学显著性。接受治疗的患者NT-proBNP水平显著低于未治疗者。NT-proBNP与年龄、性别、超声心动图或其他实验室参数无显著关联。在VAs亚组中，NT-proBNP与基线QRS时限呈中度负相关。鉴于患者人群有限，这些发现代表一项初步探索性分析。NT-proBNP应被视为反映功能性心肌劳损的支持性生物标志物，而非用于儿童心律失常分类的独立诊断工具。

title: Ventricular Arrhythmias: Epidemiology, Diagnosis and Treatment.
summary: Ventricular arrhythmias (VAs) represent a broad and clinically heterogeneous spectrum of cardiac rhythm disturbances, ranging from isolated ventricular premature beats to life-threatening ventricular fibrillation (VF) and sudden cardiac death (SCD) [...].

AI.tldr: 本文为综述，系统梳理室性心律失常的流行病学、诊断与治疗，强调其从室性早搏到室颤/心脏性猝死的临床异质性。
AI.motivation: 室性心律失常涵盖从孤立性室性早搏到危及生命的室颤和心脏性猝死的广泛谱系，临床异质性强，需要系统整合流行病学、诊断评估与治疗策略以指导临床决策。
AI.method: 研究类型为综述（摘要未报告具体检索策略、纳入文献数量及筛选方法）；摘要仅给出主题范围，未报告研究对象、样本量、干预或暴露、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据、效应量、95% 置信区间或 P 值；仅概述室性心律失常涵盖从孤立性室性早搏至室颤和心脏性猝死的连续谱。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在为室性心律失常的流行病学、诊断与治疗提供整体框架；因摘要未报告具体证据与数据，其对电生理实践的具体影响及局限性无法从摘要中评估。

summary_zh: 室性心律失常（VAs）代表了一组广泛且临床异质性显著的心律失常，范围从孤立的室性早搏到危及生命的室性颤动（VF）和心脏性猝死（SCD）[...]。

title: Growth of Cardiac Fibromas During Infancy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac fibromas commonly present in childhood as large intramyocardial tumors that are frequently associated with arrhythmias, hemodynamic compromise, sudden cardiac death, and/or associated cardiac or lung compression. Although unoperated cardiac fibromas were historically thought to remain stable in size throughout life, their natural history has not been studied.

METHODS: In this retrospective single-center study, we identified all patients with cardiac fibromas and serial cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) and/or cardiac computed tomography (CT) before or after surgical intervention to characterize fibroma growth.

RESULTS: A total of 36 infants and children with at least 2 serial imaging studies were identified. Younger age at first imaging study was associated with faster cardiac fibroma growth, with infants (<12 months) demonstrating a body surface area (BSA)-indexed growth rate of 11 ± 2mL/m2/month; whereas children older than 2.5 years demonstrated no growth (p=0.005). In one child, the tumor's unadjusted volume increased by 933% and the BSA-adjusted volume increased by 334% between CMR examinations obtained in the first week of life and at age 1.5 years. A higher T2 tumor:myocardium intensity ratio was associated with both younger age at initial examination and faster growth rate (p=0.001). A higher tumor growth rate was associated with the development of hemodynamic impact of the tumor, in particular pulmonary vein compression and/or lung compression. No significant tumor growth was observed after tumor resection.

CONCLUSIONS: Cardiac fibromas may exhibit rapid growth in infancy, and tumor growth is associated with the development of hemodynamic compromise. Based on this observation, consideration should be given to frequent monitoring of tumor size and clinical status during the first years of life.

AI.tldr: 婴儿期心脏纤维瘤可快速生长，生长速度与年龄小和T2信号比值高相关，并导致血流动力学损害。
AI.motivation: 心脏纤维瘤在儿童期常表现为大的壁内肿瘤，与心律失常、血流动力学障碍和猝死相关。传统认为未手术的纤维瘤大小稳定，但其自然病史尚未被研究。
AI.method: 回顾性单中心研究，纳入36例有至少2次系列心脏磁共振（CMR）和/或心脏CT的婴儿和儿童，分析肿瘤生长情况。
AI.result: 首次影像年龄越小生长越快：婴儿（<12个月）BSA标化生长速率为11±2 mL/m2/月，>2.5岁儿童无生长（p=0.005）。一例患儿从出生第一周至1.5岁，肿瘤未调整体积增加933%，BSA调整体积增加334%。T2肿瘤/心肌信号强度比越高与年龄小和生长快相关（p=0.001）。生长快与血流动力学影响（尤其肺静脉和/或肺受压）相关。肿瘤切除后未见明显生长。
AI.conclusion: 心脏纤维瘤在婴儿期可快速生长，并与血流动力学损害相关，提示生命早期应密切监测肿瘤大小和临床状态。

summary_zh:
背景：心脏纤维瘤通常在儿童期表现为较大的心肌内肿瘤，常与心律失常、血流动力学障碍、心源性猝死和/或相关的心脏或肺部受压相关。尽管历史上认为未手术的心脏纤维瘤在整个生命周期中大小保持稳定，但其自然病史尚未被研究。

方法：在这项回顾性单中心研究中，我们确定了所有心脏纤维瘤患者，并在手术干预前后进行了系列心血管磁共振（CMR）和/或心脏计算机断层扫描（CT）以表征纤维瘤的生长。

结果：共确定了36名至少进行过2次系列影像学检查的婴幼儿和儿童。首次影像学检查时年龄较小与心脏纤维瘤生长较快相关，婴儿（<12个月）表现出体表面积（BSA）指数化生长速率为11 ± 2mL/m2/月；而年龄大于2.5岁的儿童则无生长（p=0.005）。在一名儿童中，肿瘤的未调整体积在出生第一周和1.5岁时进行的CMR检查之间增加了933%，BSA调整后的体积增加了334%。较高的T2肿瘤：心肌强度比与初次检查时年龄较小和生长速率较快均相关（p=0.001）。较高的肿瘤生长速率与肿瘤血流动力学影响的发展相关，特别是肺静脉受压和/或肺受压。肿瘤切除后未观察到显著的肿瘤生长。

结论：心脏纤维瘤在婴儿期可能表现出快速生长，且肿瘤生长与血流动力学障碍的发展相关。基于此观察，应考虑在生命最初几年频繁监测肿瘤大小和临床状态。

title: Legionella Septic Cardiomyopathy Requiring Venoarterial Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation Followed by Presumed Complement-Mediated Thrombotic Microangiopathy: A Case Report
summary: Background:Legionella pneumophila rarely causes profound myocardial dysfunction and malignant ventricular arrhythmias. Persistent thrombocytopenia and acute kidney injury during recovery may additionally raise concern for thrombotic microangiopathy (TMA), although distinguishing complement-mediated disease from secondary causes in critically ill patients is challenging. Case Presentation: A 64-year-old man presented after five days of fever with recurrent ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation, cardiac arrest, and refractory shock. Echocardiography demonstrated diffuse biventricular hypokinesia with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 18%, while urgent coronary angiography showed no acute coronary occlusion. Venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (VA-ECMO), intra-aortic balloon counterpulsation, and organ support were initiated. Levofloxacin was administered from admission, before sputum sequencing identified L. pneumophila. VA-ECMO was removed after four days. Persistent anaemia and thrombocytopenia with progressive acute kidney injury despite clinical improvement prompted evaluation for thrombotic microangiopathy. ADAMTS13 activity was 92%, soluble C5b-9 was elevated to 648 ng/mL, and schistocytes were not identified. Presumed complement-mediated TMA was treated with four weekly doses of eculizumab, followed by haematological and renal improvement. Sepsis, extracorporeal support, transfusions, and gastrointestinal bleeding confounded diagnosis and treatment attribution. At three months, LVEF was 59%, platelet count 237 × 109/L, and creatinine 97 µmol/L. Conclusions: VA-ECMO may bridge selected patients with severe septic myocardial dysfunction to recovery. Persistent cytopenias and kidney injury warrant structured TMA evaluation.
