BACKGROUND: Variant transthyretin amyloidosis (ATTRv) remains undercharacterized in Latin America, with limited awareness of its regional mutational diversity.

CASE SUMMARY: A 48-year-old Peruvian man presented with syncope, exertional dyspnea, weight loss, and lower extremity paresthesia. Multimodality evaluation demonstrated severe infiltrative cardiomyopathy, small fiber and autonomic neuropathy, and peripheral nerve hypertrophy. Genetic testing identified a heterozygous pathogenic p.Ala65Val transthyretin variant, confirming ATTRv. No transthyretin-targeting therapies are currently accessible in Peru.

DISCUSSION: To our knowledge, only 1 prior case harboring this variant has been reported, in a European patient with a late-onset presentation. Our patient exhibited an early-onset mixed cardiac and neuropathic phenotype, broadening the clinical spectrum of this rare variant.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: This case highlights the phenotypic diversity of ATTRv and underscores the critical unmet need for disease-modifying therapy access and greater inclusion of Latin American patients in clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 秘鲁48岁男性携带TTR p.Ala65Val变异，表现为早发混合型心脏和神经病变表型，提示该变异表型多样性及拉丁美洲治疗可及性缺口。
AI.motivation: ATTRv在拉丁美洲特征不明确，区域突变多样性认识有限，既往仅报道1例欧洲晚发型p.Ala65Val变异携带者，缺乏早发混合表型的描述。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为48岁秘鲁男性，表现为晕厥、劳力性呼吸困难、体重下降和下肢感觉异常。通过多模态评估（包括基因检测）明确诊断。终点为临床表型及基因型描述。统计方法未报告。
AI.result: 多模态评估显示严重浸润性心肌病、小纤维和自主神经病变及周围神经肥大。基因检测发现杂合致病性p.Ala65Val TTR变异，确诊ATTRv。秘鲁目前无法获得靶向TTR治疗。摘要未报告定量数据。
AI.conclusion: 本例为p.Ala65Val变异相关早发混合型ATTRv，扩展了该罕见变异的临床谱，凸显ATTRv表型多样性、疾病修饰治疗可及性未满足需求及拉丁美洲患者纳入临床试验的必要性。局限性为单例报告，不能推断因果或普遍性。

summary_zh:
背景：变异型转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性（ATTRv）在拉丁美洲仍缺乏充分特征描述，对其区域突变多样性的认识有限。

病例摘要：一名48岁秘鲁男性因晕厥、劳力性呼吸困难、体重下降和下肢感觉异常就诊。多模态评估显示严重浸润性心肌病、小纤维和自主神经病变以及周围神经肥大。基因检测发现杂合致病性p.Ala65Val转甲状腺素蛋白变异，确诊ATTRv。目前秘鲁无法获得靶向转甲状腺素蛋白的治疗。

讨论：据我们所知，此前仅报道过1例携带该变异的病例，为一名晚发型表现的欧洲患者。我们的患者表现为早发型混合心脏和神经病变表型，拓宽了这种罕见变异的临床谱。

要点信息：本病例凸显了ATTRv的表型多样性，并强调了在获得疾病修饰治疗以及将拉丁美洲患者更多纳入临床试验方面存在的关键未满足需求。

title: Transthyretin Amyloidosis Due to a Rare TTR Val142del Deletion With Relatively Early Clinical Manifestations.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis shows marked phenotypic heterogeneity. In-frame deletions at codon 142 are exceedingly rare, and their cardiac expression remains poorly characterized.

CASE SUMMARY: A 62-year-old man presented with progressive neuropathy, autonomic dysfunction, weight loss, and recurrent syncope. Multimodality imaging demonstrated concentric hypertrophy with preserved ejection fraction, apical sparing on strain, diffuse late gadolinium enhancement with increased extracellular volume, and grade III uptake on 99mTc-pyrophosphate scintigraphy. Monoclonal gammopathy was excluded. Genetic testing identified a heterozygous the transthyretin p.Val142del deletion. Autonomic testing confirmed orthostatic hypotension with impaired chronotropic response. Heart failure therapy and tafamidis led to symptomatic improvement. Cascade screening identified 2 asymptomatic carriers.

DISCUSSION: Unlike the common Val142Ile substitution, this deletion appears associated with earlier penetrance and multisystem involvement.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Rare transthyretin deletions may cause aggressive hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis. Early recognition and family screening are essential.

AI.tldr: 一例62岁男性因罕见TTR p.Val142del缺失表现为早发多系统转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性，经tafamidis治疗症状改善，家系筛查发现2例无症状携带者。
AI.motivation: 遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性表型异质性显著，密码子142框内缺失极为罕见，其心脏表现尚不明确，临床认识不足。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为62岁男性，表现为进行性神经病、自主神经功能障碍、体重下降和反复晕厥。通过多模态影像学、99mTc-焦磷酸盐闪烁显像、基因检测和自主神经功能测试进行评估，并开展家系筛查。
AI.result: 影像学显示向心性肥厚伴射血分数保留、应变显像心尖保留、弥漫性晚期钆增强伴细胞外容积增加，99mTc-PYP显像为3级摄取；排除单克隆丙种球蛋白病；基因检测发现杂合TTR p.Val142del缺失；自主神经测试证实直立性低血压伴变时反应受损。心衰治疗联合tafamidis后症状改善，家系筛查发现2例无症状携带者。
AI.conclusion: 罕见TTR缺失可导致侵袭性遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性，与常见Val142Ile替换不同，该缺失外显率更早且多系统受累。早期识别和家系筛查至关重要，对电生理实践提示需警惕此类患者的心脏受累及自主神经功能障碍。

summary_zh:
背景：遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性表现出显著的表型异质性。第142位密码子的框内缺失极为罕见，其心脏表现特征仍不明确。

病例摘要：一名62岁男性表现为进行性神经病变、自主神经功能障碍、体重下降和反复晕厥。多模态影像显示向心性肥厚伴射血分数保留、应变显像心尖保留、弥漫性晚期钆增强伴细胞外容积增加，以及99mTc-焦磷酸盐闪烁显像III级摄取。排除了单克隆丙种球蛋白病。基因检测发现杂合性转甲状腺素蛋白p.Val142del缺失。自主神经测试证实直立性低血压伴变时反应受损。心力衰竭治疗和tafamidis使症状改善。级联筛查发现2名无症状携带者。

讨论：与常见的Val142Ile替换不同，这种缺失似乎与更早的外显率和多系统受累相关。

要点：罕见的转甲状腺素蛋白缺失可能导致侵袭性遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性。早期识别和家族筛查至关重要。

title: Sustained Ventricular Tachycardia as the First Presentation of Hereditary Transthyretin Amyloidosis With the Glu109Gln Mutation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) most commonly presents with heart failure symptoms. Sustained ventricular tachycardia (VT) is an uncommon initial manifestation.

CASE SUMMARY: A 57-year-old man presented with hemodynamically unstable monomorphic VT requiring cardioversion. Imaging suggested cardiac amyloidosis and bone scintigraphy demonstrated Perugini grade 3 uptake. Genetic testing revealed a pathogenic p.Glu109Gln variant in the transthyretin gene. An implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) was implanted, and ATTR-stabilizer therapy was initiated. The patient remains stable without recurrent VT after 2.5 years.

DISCUSSION: This case highlights VT as a rare initial presentation of ATTR-CM and emphasizes the limited evidence guiding the management of ventricular arrhythmias and the role of ICDs in these patients. Notably, the patient remained free of recurrent ventricular arrhythmias and ICD therapies during 2.5 years of follow-up without antiarrhythmic therapy.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: VT may represent an atypical presentation of ATTR-CM. Management of ventricular arrhythmias remains individualized due to limited evidence.

AI.tldr: 57岁男性以持续性室速为首发表现，基因检测确诊Glu109Gln突变型遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性心肌病，植入ICD并启动稳定剂治疗后2.5年无室速复发。
AI.motivation: 转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样变性心肌病（ATTR-CM）通常以心力衰竭症状起病，持续性室性心动过速（VT）作为首发表现罕见；目前对这类患者室性心律失常的管理及ICD的作用证据有限，需要个案积累以指导临床决策。
AI.method: 病例报告。研究对象为1例57岁男性，因血流动力学不稳定的单形性VT需电复律就诊。通过影像学提示心脏淀粉样变性、骨闪烁显像显示Perugini 3级摄取，并经基因检测发现转甲状腺素蛋白基因致病性p.Glu109Gln变异确诊。干预包括植入ICD和启动ATTR稳定剂治疗。主要观察终点为VT复发及ICD治疗情况，随访2.5年。统计方法为描述性总结，摘要未报告。
AI.result: 患者以血流动力学不稳定的单形性VT为首发表现，需电复律。影像学提示心脏淀粉样变性，骨闪烁显像Perugini 3级，基因检测证实p.Glu109Gln致病性变异。植入ICD并启动ATTR稳定剂治疗后，随访2.5年患者病情稳定，未接受抗心律失常药物治疗，无VT复发及ICD治疗。摘要未报告其他定量数据或统计检验结果。
AI.conclusion: VT可作为ATTR-CM的非典型首发表现，临床需警惕。由于证据有限，此类患者室性心律失常的管理及ICD适应证应个体化决策；本例在未用抗心律失常药物情况下2.5年无复发，提示部分患者可能预后良好，但作为单例报告结论外推受限，需更多研究明确ICD在该人群中的价值。

summary_zh:
背景：转甲状腺素蛋白淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）最常表现为心力衰竭症状。持续性室性心动过速（VT）是一种不常见的初始表现。

病例摘要：一名57岁男性因血流动力学不稳定的单形性VT就诊，需电复律。影像学提示心脏淀粉样变性，骨闪烁显像显示Perugini 3级摄取。基因检测发现转甲状腺素蛋白基因致病性p.Glu109Gln变异。植入植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD），并开始ATTR稳定剂治疗。2.5年后患者病情稳定，无VT复发。

讨论：本病例强调VT是ATTR-CM罕见的初始表现，并强调指导室性心律失常管理和ICD在这些患者中作用的证据有限。值得注意的是，患者在2.5年随访期间未接受抗心律失常治疗，无复发性室性心律失常和ICD治疗。

要点：VT可能代表ATTR-CM的非典型表现。由于证据有限，室性心律失常的管理仍应个体化。

title: Rare Hereditary Cardiac Amyloidosis Treated With SGLT2 Inhibitor: Beyond ATTR/AL.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Rare hereditary cardiac amyloidosis (CA) may mimic transthyretin or light-chain cardiomyopathy, and reports for effective therapy in these entities are limited.

CASE SUMMARY: A 61-year-old man presented with progressive heart failure (NYHA functional class III). Medical history included bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome, chronic kidney disease, and family history notable for amyloidosis in his brother and suspected CA-related death in their mother. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging showed late gadolinium enhancement consistent with CA, echocardiography increased left ventricular thickness and diastolic dysfunction. Light-chain CA was excluded. Genetic testing identified an Apolipoprotein A-I (ApoA1) mutation (p.L202P). ApoA1 amyloid was confirmed in a gastric biopsy. Therapy with dapagliflozin led to clinical improvement.

DISCUSSION: Recognition of ApoA1-associated CA relies on clinical history and genetic confirmation. Screening of first-degree relatives is advised. SGLT2-inhibitor therapy may improve symptoms, extrapolated from observational transthyretin-cardiomyopathy studies.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Rare hereditary CA represents an important differential diagnosis in CA cases. Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors may represent a treatment option.

AI.tldr: 一例61岁男性ApoA1突变相关罕见遗传性心脏淀粉样变性患者，在排除ATTR/AL后使用达格列净治疗获得临床改善。
AI.motivation: 罕见遗传性心脏淀粉样变性（CA）易与转甲状腺素蛋白（ATTR）或轻链（AL）心肌病混淆，且针对这类疾病的治疗证据有限，临床识别和治疗选择存在缺口。
AI.method: 病例报告。患者为61岁男性，表现为进行性心力衰竭（NYHA III级），有双侧腕管综合征、慢性肾脏病及家族史。通过心脏磁共振（晚期钆增强）、超声心动图（左室增厚、舒张功能障碍）评估，排除轻链CA，基因检测发现载脂蛋白A-I（ApoA1）突变（p.L202P），胃活检证实ApoA1淀粉样物质沉积。给予达格列净治疗，观察临床反应。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 达格列净治疗后患者获得临床改善。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 罕见遗传性CA是CA鉴别诊断中的重要考虑，ApoA1相关CA的诊断依赖临床病史和基因确认，建议对一级亲属进行筛查。SGLT2抑制剂可能改善症状，但其证据来自ATTR心肌病的观察性研究外推，需进一步验证。

summary_zh:
背景：罕见遗传性心脏淀粉样变性（CA）可能模仿转甲状腺素蛋白或轻链心肌病，针对这些疾病有效治疗的报道有限。

病例摘要：一名61岁男性表现为进行性心力衰竭（NYHA功能分级III级）。病史包括双侧腕管综合征、慢性肾脏病，家族史值得注意的是其兄弟患有淀粉样变性，其母亲疑似CA相关死亡。心脏磁共振成像显示晚期钆增强，符合CA，超声心动图显示左心室厚度增加和舒张功能障碍。排除了轻链CA。基因检测发现载脂蛋白A-I（ApoA1）突变（p.L202P）。胃活检证实ApoA1淀粉样变性。达格列净治疗导致临床改善。

讨论：识别ApoA1相关CA依赖于临床病史和基因确认。建议对一级亲属进行筛查。SGLT2抑制剂治疗可能改善症状，这是从观察性转甲状腺素蛋白心肌病研究外推的。

要点信息：罕见遗传性CA是CA病例中的重要鉴别诊断。钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂可能是一种治疗选择。

title: Complete Atrioventricular Block in an HLA-B27-Positive Woman Without Overt Spondyloarthritis
summary: Background Complete atrioventricular block (CAVB) in adults younger than 50 years warrants investigation for inflammatory, infiltrative, infectious, autoimmune, and inherited disorders. Human leukocyte antigen B27 (HLA-B27)-associated conduction disease without overt spondyloarthritis is exceptionally rare.Case summary A 43-year-old physically active woman presented with symptomatic CAVB requiring dual-chamber pacemaker implantation. She had recurrent HLA-B27-positive anterior uveitis and Hashimoto thyroiditis but no clinical evidence of spondyloarthritis. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging, fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography, comprehensive genetic testing, and an extensive autoimmune evaluation were unrevealing, supporting a diagnosis of exclusion.Discussion Although atrioventricular conduction abnormalities are recognized in ankylosing spondylitis, isolated CAVB associated with HLA-B27 in the absence of overt spondyloarthritis has rarely been reported. This case broadens the recognized clinical spectrum of HLA-B27-associated disease and highlights recurrent HLA-B27-positive uveitis as a potential diagnostic clue in otherwise unexplained CAVB.Take-home messages HLA-B27 testing should be considered in selected younger patients with unexplained CAVB and suggestive immune-mediated features. A multidisciplinary evaluation is essential after exclusion of structural, inflammatory, infectious, autoimmune, and inherited causes.

AI.tldr: 一例43岁HLA-B27阳性女性无明确脊柱关节炎却发生完全性房室传导阻滞，需双腔起搏器植入，提示HLA-B27相关传导疾病谱可能更广。
AI.motivation: 50岁以下成人完全性房室传导阻滞（CAVB）需排查炎症、浸润、感染、自身免疫及遗传性疾病。已知强直性脊柱炎可伴房室传导异常，但HLA-B27阳性而无明显脊柱关节炎的孤立性CAVB极为罕见，既往证据有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为43岁体力活动正常的女性，因症状性CAVB需植入双腔起搏器。她有复发性HLA-B27阳性前葡萄膜炎和桥本甲状腺炎，但无脊柱关节炎临床证据。进行了心脏磁共振、氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描、全面基因检测及广泛自身免疫评估。
AI.result: 上述影像、基因及自身免疫检查均无异常发现，支持排除性诊断。摘要未报告具体统计数值。
AI.conclusion: HLA-B27相关疾病谱可能包括无 overt 脊柱关节炎的孤立性CAVB，复发性HLA-B27阳性葡萄膜炎可作为不明原因CAVB的诊断线索。对选择性年轻不明原因CAVB且伴免疫介导特征者应考虑HLA-B27检测，并需多学科评估排除结构、炎症、感染、自身免疫及遗传病因。局限性为单例报告，不能推断因果关系。

summary_zh:
背景：50岁以下成人发生完全性房室传导阻滞（CAVB）需排查炎症性、浸润性、感染性、自身免疫性及遗传性疾病。人类白细胞抗原B27（HLA-B27）相关传导疾病而无明显脊柱关节炎者极为罕见。

病例摘要：一名43岁体力活动活跃的女性因症状性CAVB就诊，需植入双腔起搏器。她有复发性HLA-B27阳性前葡萄膜炎和桥本甲状腺炎，但无脊柱关节炎的临床证据。心脏磁共振成像、氟脱氧葡萄糖正电子发射断层扫描、全面基因检测及广泛的自身免疫评估均无异常发现，支持排除性诊断。

讨论：尽管强直性脊柱炎中已认识到房室传导异常，但HLA-B27相关且无明显脊柱关节炎的孤立性CAVB鲜有报道。本病例拓宽了HLA-B27相关疾病的已知临床谱，并强调复发性HLA-B27阳性葡萄膜炎可作为其他原因不明CAVB的潜在诊断线索。

要点：对于原因不明CAVB且具有提示免疫介导特征的特定年轻患者，应考虑进行HLA-B27检测。在排除结构性、炎症性、感染性、自身免疫性及遗传性病因后，多学科评估至关重要。

title: Shared genetic architecture of HCM and AF: Elevated NPPA/ANP is linked to atrial electrical remodeling.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) patients exhibit heightened susceptibility to atrial fibrillation (AF), yet the underlying genetic nexus remains poorly defined. This study aimed to identify genes common to HCM and AF, thereby revealing the underlying pathogenesis of susceptibility to AF in HCM patients.

METHODS: Genes associated with HCM and AF were sourced from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO), Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM), Comparative Toxicogenomics Database (CTD), GeneCards, and DisGeNET databases. We conducted a comparative analysis to identify overlapping genes between HCM and AF for further investigation, which included functional enrichment analysis, protein-protein interaction networks, and immune infiltration assessment. Key hub genes were determined using cytoHubba, a Cytoscape plugin, and their validation was performed using independent datasets GSE36961 and GSE115574. The genes corroborated by these datasets were additionally validated in clinical samples.

RESULTS: A total of 11 overlapping genes were identified between HCM and AF. Functional enrichment and immune infiltration analyses revealed their involvement in immune regulation and inflammatory processes. Three hub genes NPPA, ACE, and POMC were recognized as key molecular links between HCM and AF. Validation using the GSE36961 dataset confirmed the upregulation of NPPA in HCM, supporting its potential as a central gene connecting the two conditions. Consistent with the bioinformatics findings, exploratory clinical verification findings of serum levels of N-terminal fragment of A-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proANP), encoded by NPPA, were markedly elevated in both the HCM and HCM with AF groups compared with healthy controls (P < 0.01). Moreover, NT-proANP concentrations were significantly higher in the HCM + AF group than in the HCM-only group (P < 0.01).

CONCLUSION: This study identifies a shared genetic link between HCM and AF. The findings strongly associate elevated NT-proANP levels, encoded by the NPPA gene, with AF in HCM patients. We propose NT-proANP as a promising circulating biomarker for stratifying AF risk in this patient population.

AI.tldr: 生物信息学与临床验证发现 HCM 与 AF 共享 11 个重叠基因，NPPA 编码的 NT-proANP 在 HCM 合并 AF 患者中显著升高，或可作为 AF 风险分层标志物。
AI.motivation: 肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者对心房颤动（AF）易感性明显增高，但两者共同的遗传基础尚不明确，缺乏可用于识别 HCM 患者 AF 风险的分子标志物。
AI.method: 研究为生物信息学分析联合探索性临床验证。从 GEO、OMIM、CTD、GeneCards、DisGeNET 数据库获取 HCM 与 AF 相关基因，比较取交集基因，进行功能富集分析、蛋白-蛋白互作网络与免疫浸润评估；用 Cytoscape 插件 cytoHubba 筛选 hub 基因，并在独立数据集 GSE36961 与 GSE115574 中验证，随后在临床样本中检测血清 NT-proANP 水平。
AI.result: 共识别 11 个 HCM 与 AF 重叠基因，功能富集与免疫浸润分析提示其参与免疫调节和炎症过程；确定 NPPA、ACE、POMC 三个 hub 基因。GSE36961 验证显示 HCM 中 NPPA 上调。临床验证中，HCM 组与 HCM 合并 AF 组血清 NT-proANP 均显著高于健康对照（P<0.01），且 HCM+AF 组显著高于单纯 HCM 组（P<0.01）。摘要未报告效应量与 95%CI。
AI.conclusion: 研究提示 HCM 与 AF 存在共享遗传联系，NPPA 编码的 NT-proANP 升高与 HCM 患者合并 AF 密切相关，有望作为该人群 AF 风险分层的循环生物标志物。但临床验证为探索性、样本量未报告，尚需前瞻性大样本研究确认其预测价值及对电生理筛查策略的影响。

summary_zh:
背景：肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者对心房颤动（AF）的易感性增高，但其潜在的遗传联系仍不明确。本研究旨在识别HCM和AF共有的基因，从而揭示HCM患者对AF易感性的潜在发病机制。

方法：从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）、在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库（OMIM）、比较毒理基因组学数据库（CTD）、GeneCards和DisGeNET数据库中获取与HCM和AF相关的基因。我们进行比较分析以识别HCM和AF之间的重叠基因以进一步研究，包括功能富集分析、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络和免疫浸润评估。使用Cytoscape插件cytoHubba确定关键枢纽基因，并使用独立数据集GSE36961和GSE115574进行验证。经这些数据集证实的基因在临床样本中进一步验证。

结果：在HCM和AF之间共识别出11个重叠基因。功能富集和免疫浸润分析揭示它们参与免疫调节和炎症过程。三个枢纽基因NPPA、ACE和POMC被认定为HCM和AF之间的关键分子联系。使用GSE36961数据集验证证实了NPPA在HCM中的上调，支持其作为连接这两种疾病的中心基因的潜力。与生物信息学发现一致，探索性临床验证发现，由NPPA编码的A型利钠肽N端片段（NT-proANP）的血清水平在HCM组和HCM合并AF组中均显著高于健康对照组（P < 0.01）。此外，HCM + AF组的NT-proANP浓度显著高于单纯HCM组（P < 0.01）。

结论：本研究确定了HCM和AF之间的共享遗传联系。研究结果强烈表明，由NPPA基因编码的NT-proANP水平升高与HCM患者的AF相关。我们提出NT-proANP作为一种有前景的循环生物标志物，用于对该患者群体进行AF风险分层。

title: Clinical Presentation, Diagnosis, Treatment, and Outcome of Heart Disease in Becker Muscular Dystrophy
summary: Becker muscular dystrophy (BMD) is a primary myopathy caused by mutations in the dystrophin gene on chromosome Xq21.2, which often affects the myocardium and cardiac conduction system. However, there is limited experience with cardiac disease in BMD. This review aims to summarize and discuss recent advances and future perspectives regarding the clinical presentation, diagnosis, treatment, and outcome of cardiac involvement in BMD. Data were retrieved by searching for relevant articles in the PubMed and Google Scholar databases. Cardiac disease in BMD is characterized by myocardial fibrosis, can be subclinical or clinical, and manifests as left or right ventricular systolic dysfunction with/without heart failure due to dilated or hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, diastolic dysfunction with preserved/decreased systolic function, conduction disturbances and supraventricular/ventricular arrhythmias, thrombus formation, arterial hypertension, pulmonary hypertension, left ventricular hypertrabeculation, coronary artery disease, and valve defects. Cardiac involvement in BMD must be detected and treated at an early stage, because it progresses over time and has a significant impact on the course of the disease. Established treatment methods include non-invasive therapies with small molecules and catheter-based invasive therapies (stent implantation, endocardial and epicardial ablation), device-related treatments (pacemaker, implantable cardioverter-defibrillator, cardiac resynchronization therapy, left ventricular assist device), and heart surgery. Cardiac involvement in BMD occurs in about two-thirds of patients, is subclinical in the early stages but becomes symptomatic as the heart disease progresses, requires early diagnosis, and can be treated with non-invasive and invasive therapies, with prognosis improving with early detection and adequate treatment.

AI.tldr: Becker型肌营养不良症约三分之二患者累及心脏，早期亚临床、随病程进展出现症状，早期诊断和适当治疗可改善预后。
AI.motivation: Becker型肌营养不良症（BMD）是Xq21.2染色体dystrophin基因突变所致的原发性肌病，常累及心肌和心脏传导系统，但关于BMD心脏病变的临床经验有限，缺乏系统总结。本文旨在综述BMD心脏受累的临床表现、诊断、治疗和预后进展。
AI.method: 综述性研究。通过检索PubMed和Google Scholar数据库获取相关文献，总结和讨论BMD心脏受累的临床表现、诊断、治疗及预后。未报告系统评价或荟萃分析的具体方法学细节。
AI.result: BMD心脏病变以心肌纤维化为特征，可表现为亚临床或临床型，包括左或右心室收缩功能不全伴或不伴心力衰竭（扩张型或肥厚型心肌病）、舒张功能不全伴收缩功能保留或减低、传导障碍、室上性或室性心律失常、血栓形成、动脉高血压、肺动脉高压、左心室过度小梁化、冠状动脉疾病和瓣膜缺陷。摘要未报告具体患病率、效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: BMD心脏受累约见于三分之二患者，早期亚临床、随心脏病进展出现症状，需早期诊断；治疗包括小分子非侵入性治疗、导管介入治疗（支架植入、心内膜和心外膜消融）、器械治疗（起搏器、ICD、CRT、左心室辅助装置）和心脏手术，早期发现和充分治疗可改善预后。本文为综述，未提供原始研究数据，结论基于文献总结，需进一步前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: Becker型肌营养不良症（BMD）是一种由染色体Xq21.2上抗肌萎缩蛋白基因突变引起的原发性肌病，常累及心肌和心脏传导系统。然而，关于BMD心脏病的经验有限。本综述旨在总结和讨论BMD心脏受累的临床表现、诊断、治疗和转归方面的最新进展和未来展望。数据通过检索PubMed和Google Scholar数据库中的相关文章获取。BMD的心脏病以心肌纤维化为特征，可为亚临床或临床型，表现为左或右心室收缩功能障碍伴/不伴心力衰竭（由扩张型或肥厚型心肌病所致）、舒张功能障碍伴收缩功能保留/减低、传导障碍和室上性/室性心律失常、血栓形成、动脉性高血压、肺动脉高压、左心室过度小梁化、冠状动脉疾病和瓣膜缺陷。BMD的心脏受累必须早期发现和治疗，因为它随时间进展并对疾病病程有显著影响。已确立的治疗方法包括小分子非侵入性治疗和导管侵入性治疗（支架植入、心内膜和心外膜消融）、器械相关治疗（起搏器、植入式心律转复除颤器、心脏再同步治疗、左心室辅助装置）以及心脏手术。BMD的心脏受累发生于约三分之二的患者，早期为亚临床型，但随着心脏病进展出现症状，需要早期诊断，并可通过非侵入性和侵入性方法治疗，早期发现和充分治疗可改善预后。

title: Calmodulin mutation N54I causes autosomal dominant CPVT in mice.
summary: Catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT) is an inherited arrhythmia syndrome characterized by stress- or catecholamine-induced ventricular arrhythmias in the absence of overt structural heart disease. Mutations in RYR2 and CASQ2 account for most genetically defined cases, although pathogenic variants in the three genes encoding calmodulin (CALM1-3) have also been linked to CPVT. Because all three CALM genes encode an identical calmodulin protein, pathogenic calmodulin variants are expected to be expressed in only a small fraction of total cellular calmodulin, raising the question of whether this limited abundance is sufficient to produce an arrhythmogenic phenotype in vivo. We generated a heterozygous mouse model carrying the human disease-associated N54I-equivalent mutation, N54I, in Calm1. Mutant calmodulin accounted for 13.7% of total cardiac calmodulin, consistent with expression from one of six Calm alleles. Under basal conditions, N54I/+ mice exhibited normal growth, survival, cardiac morphology, and surface electrocardiogram parameters. However, cardiomyocytes isolated from N54I/+ mice had increased rates of RyR2-mediated spontaneous calcium release. Following catecholaminergic challenge with isoproterenol and caffeine, N54I/+ mice exhibited significantly more premature ventricular contractions and arrhythmias than wild-type littermates. Exercise challenge in conscious mice similarly provoked ventricular ectopy and ventricular tachycardia. In addition, N54I/+ mice exhibited abnormalities of atrial and sinoatrial electrical activity, including premature atrial contractions, ectopic P waves, atrioventricular conduction slowing, and beat-to-beat variability. These findings demonstrate that expression of the N54I calmodulin variant from a single Calm1 allele is sufficient to produce a CPVT phenotype in vivo. This model provides experimental evidence linking a human disease-associated calmodulin variant to arrhythmogenesis and demonstrates the functional dominance of mutant calmodulin in the heart.

AI.tldr: 携带Calm1 N54I杂合突变的小鼠（突变钙调蛋白仅占心脏总钙调蛋白13.7%）在基础状态下正常，但 catecholamine 或运动激发后出现室性早搏、室性心动过速及心房/窦房结电活动异常，证实该突变足以在体内产生CPVT表型。
AI.motivation: CPVT是应激诱发的遗传性心律失常综合征，多数由RYR2和CASQ2突变引起，CALM1-3编码完全相同的钙调蛋白，致病突变仅占细胞总钙调蛋白一小部分，这种低丰度是否足以在体内产生致心律失常表型尚不明确，既往缺乏直接证据。
AI.method: 研究类型：遗传与基础研究，采用基因敲入小鼠模型。对象：携带人类疾病相关N54I等效突变（Calm1 N54I）的杂合子小鼠（N54I/+）及野生型同窝对照。样本量：摘要未报告。干预/暴露：Calm1单等位基因N54I突变，突变钙调蛋白占心脏总钙调蛋白13.7%。终点：基础状态生长、生存、心脏形态和体表心电图参数；分离心肌细胞RyR2介导的自发钙释放频率；异丙肾上腺素+咖啡因激发后室性早搏和心律失常；清醒小鼠运动激发后室性异位搏动和室性心动过速；心房和窦房电活动异常。统计方法：摘要未报告。
AI.result: N54I/+小鼠基础状态下生长、生存、心脏形态和体表心电图参数均正常；分离心肌细胞RyR2介导的自发钙释放频率增加。异丙肾上腺素+咖啡因激发后，N54I/+小鼠室性早搏和心律失常显著多于野生型同窝对照（具体数值、95%CI和P值摘要未报告）。清醒小鼠运动激发同样诱发室性异位搏动和室性心动过速。此外，N54I/+小鼠出现心房和窦房电活动异常，包括房性早搏、异位P波、房室传导减慢和逐搏变异性。
AI.conclusion: Calm1单等位基因表达N54I突变钙调蛋白足以在体内产生CPVT表型，为人类疾病相关钙调蛋白突变与致心律失常作用之间提供了实验证据，并证明突变钙调蛋白在心脏中具有功能显性。该模型有助于理解钙调蛋白相关CPVT的机制，但研究为小鼠模型，样本量和统计细节未报告，向人类临床实践的转化需进一步验证。

summary_zh: 儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）是一种遗传性心律失常综合征，其特征是在无明显结构性心脏病的情况下，由应激或儿茶酚胺诱发的室性心律失常。RYR2和CASQ2的突变解释了大多数遗传学确诊的病例，尽管编码钙调蛋白的三个基因（CALM1-3）的致病性变异也与CPVT相关。由于所有三个CALM基因编码相同的钙调蛋白，致病性钙调蛋白变异预计仅表达于总细胞钙调蛋白的一小部分，这提出了一个问题：这种有限的丰度是否足以在体内产生致心律失常表型。我们构建了携带人类疾病相关N54I等效突变N54I的Calm1杂合小鼠模型。突变钙调蛋白占心脏总钙调蛋白的13.7%，与六个Calm等位基因中一个的表达一致。在基础条件下，N54I/+小鼠表现出正常的生长、存活、心脏形态和体表心电图参数。然而，从N54I/+小鼠分离的心肌细胞中RyR2介导的自发性钙释放速率增加。在异丙肾上腺素和咖啡因的儿茶酚胺能激发后，N54I/+小鼠表现出比野生型同窝仔鼠显著更多的室性早搏和心律失常。在清醒小鼠中进行运动激发同样诱发了室性异位搏动和室性心动过速。此外，N54I/+小鼠表现出心房和窦房电活动异常，包括房性早搏、异位P波、房室传导减慢和逐搏变异性。这些发现表明，从单个Calm1等位基因表达N54I钙调蛋白变异足以在体内产生CPVT表型。该模型提供了实验证据，将人类疾病相关钙调蛋白变异与心律失常发生联系起来，并证明了突变钙调蛋白在心脏中的功能优势。

title: The Impacts of Hypocalcemia on QT Interval Duration.
summary: Editor's note: This is the next installment in a series on electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation. Nurses in all settings should know the basics, as medications and physiological changes can cause cardiac arrhythmias. Each article will start with a brief case scenario and an ECG strip and then take you step by step through analyzing the heart rhythm.

AI.tldr: 本文为教学综述，未提供原始研究数据，重点讲解低钙血症与QT间期延长的关系及心电图识别要点。
AI.motivation: 临床各科室护士均需掌握心电图判读基础，因为药物与生理变化可诱发心律失常；低钙血症是可逆性QT间期延长的常见原因，但临床识别与重视不足。
AI.method: 本文为《美国护理杂志》心电图判读系列教学文章，采用病例情景加心电图条带的形式，逐步演示心律分析方法；摘要未报告研究设计、样本量、干预措施、终点定义或统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果，未提供QT间期、血钙水平、效应量、95%置信区间或P值等数据。
AI.conclusion: 文章强调护士应识别低钙血症所致QT间期延长，以早期发现并处理潜在的恶性心律失常风险；但本文属教学综述，缺乏原始研究证据，结论的临床推广价值有限。

summary_zh: 编者按：这是心电图（ECG）解读系列文章的下一部分。所有护理环境的护士都应掌握基础知识，因为药物和生理变化可导致心律失常。每篇文章将以一个简要的病例场景和一条心电图条带开始，然后逐步引导您分析心律。

title: Adaptive feature fusion based semi-supervised federated learning system for ECG arrhythmia detection.
summary: Automatic cardiac arrhythmia detection using electrocardiogram (ECG) signals is essential for early diagnosis of cardiovascular conditions. Most of the previously existing systems for arrhythmia detection depend on fully supervised learning approaches. In addition to that, since the ECG patient data is centrally stored, it can raise concerns like privacy and security in healthcare environments. To address these issues, this work explores a semi-supervised federated learning framework that detects arrhythmia using ECG signals. The MIT-BIH Arrhythmia dataset is used from which the heartbeat segments are extracted and relevant features are obtained. The framework incorporates the use of multi-level feature extraction, adaptive feature fusion and pseudo-labeling to utilize both labeled and unlabeled data efficiently. In order to improve the performance of the model, a weighted federated aggregation approach is used where the contribution of each of the clients is considered during the global model updates. Implementation and evaluation of multiple machine learning and deep learning models including Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbor, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting and Multi-Layer Perceptron are performed within the proposed framework. This proposed approach achieves an accuracy of 96.81% in semi-supervised federated settings and has an AUC value of 0.9957 that shows high classification reliability. The system helps improve the model learning with limited number of labeled data at the same time ensuring privacy preserving distributed training. The model maintains a competitive performance under federated settings as compared to the centralized training. Among the evaluated models, ensemble and neural network based approaches show superior performance. The framework demonstrates a stable performance across federated training rounds. Overall, the results obtained show the effectiveness of the proposed framework for arrhythmia detection in a simulated federated setting.

AI.tldr: 基于自适应特征融合的半监督联邦学习框架在MIT-BIH数据集上实现96.81%准确率和0.9957的AUC，隐私保护下检测心律失常。
AI.motivation: 自动心律失常检测多依赖全监督学习，且集中存储ECG数据存在隐私安全隐患，需探索半监督联邦学习框架以利用未标注数据并保护隐私。
AI.method: 使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据集提取心搏片段和特征，构建多级特征提取、自适应特征融合和伪标签的半监督联邦学习框架，采用加权联邦聚合，在框架内实现并评估随机森林、SVM、KNN、AdaBoost、梯度提升和多层感知机等多种模型。
AI.result: 半监督联邦设置下准确率达96.81%，AUC为0.9957；集成和神经网络方法表现更优，模型在联邦训练轮次间性能稳定，与集中式训练相比保持竞争性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在模拟联邦环境下有效检测心律失常，利用有限标注数据并保护隐私，对电生理实践有潜在应用价值，但需真实临床环境验证。

summary_zh: 使用心电图（ECG）信号进行自动心律失常检测对于心血管疾病的早期诊断至关重要。以往大多数心律失常检测系统依赖于全监督学习方法。除此之外，由于ECG患者数据集中存储，在医疗环境中可能引发隐私和安全方面的担忧。为解决这些问题，本工作探索了一种利用ECG信号检测心律失常的半监督联邦学习框架。使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据集，从中提取心搏片段并获取相关特征。该框架结合了多级特征提取、自适应特征融合和伪标签技术，以高效利用有标签和无标签数据。为了提高模型性能，采用加权联邦聚合方法，在全局模型更新时考虑每个客户端的贡献。在所提出的框架内，对多种机器学习和深度学习模型进行了实现与评估，包括随机森林、支持向量机、K近邻、AdaBoost、梯度提升和多层感知机。该提出的方法在半监督联邦设置下达到96.81%的准确率，AUC值为0.9957，显示出高分类可靠性。该系统有助于在有限标注数据下改善模型学习，同时确保隐私保护的分布式训练。与集中式训练相比，该模型在联邦设置下保持了有竞争力的性能。在评估的模型中，基于集成和神经网络的方法表现出优越性能。该框架在联邦训练轮次中表现出稳定的性能。总体而言，所获得的结果显示了所提出框架在模拟联邦设置下用于心律失常检测的有效性。

title: Double transition in ventricular preexcitation.
summary: In the Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome, numerous electrocardiographic (ECG) algorithms have been developed for the prediction of accessory pathway (AP) location. In addition to such algorithms, recognizing simple, unique and eye-catching ECG patterns that are specific for particular AP positions can provide further visual aid in quickly predicting the likely effective ablation site. Recently, such a distinctive ECG configuration has been introduced that showed high specificity for right posteroseptal (right paraseptal) APs. The "double transition" sign was characterized by showing more positive QRS complexes in lead V2 than in either of its neighboring leads V1 and V3. In some cases, the entire QRS complex was downgoing in V1 and V3, but upgoing in V2. In the double transition study, no explanation was provided as to the cause of this curious phenomenon, and why it had high specificity but low sensitivity for right posteroseptal APs. In this report we present our experience with the double transition sign, expand on its electrocardiographic spectrum, and offer a simple and rational explanation for the probable cause of this seemingly strange and perplexing phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文报告双移行征（V2导联QRS较V1、V3更正向）在右后间隔旁路定位中的心电表现谱，并首次提出其可能的电生理机制解释。
AI.motivation: Wolff-Parkinson-White综合征中已有多种心电图算法预测旁路位置，近期发现的双移行征对右后间隔（右旁间隔）旁路具有高特异性但低敏感性，然而既往研究未解释该现象的成因及其敏感性低的原因，临床对其识别与机制理解不足。
AI.method: 本文为病例报告/经验总结类研究（非系统对照研究），基于作者对双移行征的心电图观察经验，扩展其心电图表现谱，并对该征象的可能机制提出理论解释；摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量数据、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；作者描述双移行征表现为V2导联QRS波较相邻V1、V3更正向，部分病例V1与V3导联QRS主波向下而V2向上，并据此提出该现象的可能机制解释。
AI.conclusion: 双移行征可作为快速预测右后间隔旁路消融靶点的简易视觉辅助指标，本文补充了其心电图谱并给出机制假说；但该征象敏感性低，且本文为经验性报告、缺乏系统验证，其机制解释仍需进一步电生理标测研究证实。

summary_zh: 在Wolff-Parkinson-White综合征中，已开发出众多心电图（ECG）算法用于预测旁路（AP）位置。除这些算法外，识别针对特定AP位置的简单、独特且引人注目的ECG模式，可为快速预测可能有效的消融部位提供进一步的视觉辅助。最近，一种独特的ECG形态被引入，其对右后间隔（右旁间隔）AP显示出高特异性。“双过渡”征的特征是V2导联的QRS波群比其相邻的V1和V3导联更呈正向。在某些病例中，整个QRS波群在V1和V3导联向下，但在V2导联向上。在双过渡研究中，未提供关于这一奇特现象原因的解释，也未解释为何其对右后间隔AP具有高特异性但低敏感性。在本报告中，我们呈现我们对双过渡征的经验，扩展其心电图谱，并为这一看似奇怪且令人困惑现象的可能原因提供简单合理的解释。

Wearable ECG Quality Assessment: A Deep Learning and Ambulatory Context-Awareness Approach
summary: This paper presents and evaluates a Deep Learning-based (DL-based) Signal Quality Assessment (SQA) model to distinguish between clean and noisy ambulatory Electrocardiograms (ECG). The model is trained on Copenhagen Center for Health Technology-Contextualized Arrhythmia Database (CACHET-CADB), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first ambulatory ECG database with both physical and patient-reported contextual data. The model shows stable performance on different databases such as MIT-databases and the latest PyhsioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021 databases. Subsequently, the paper demonstrates how complicated ECG noise can be investigated by the SQA model and the physical contextual data.

AI.tldr: 基于深度学习的可穿戴心电信号质量评估模型在多个数据库上表现稳定，并能结合情境数据解析复杂噪声。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴心电监测在动态环境中易受噪声干扰，影响心律失常检测准确性；现有信号质量评估模型缺乏对患者情境数据的整合，且跨数据库泛化性证据不足。
AI.method: 研究提出并评估一种基于深度学习的信号质量评估模型，用于区分清洁与含噪的动态心电信号。模型在CACHET-CADB数据库上训练，该数据库为首个包含物理与患者报告情境数据的动态心电数据库。模型在MIT数据库和PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021数据库上测试性能，并利用信号质量评估模型与物理情境数据探究复杂心电噪声。摘要未报告样本量、终点定义及具体统计方法。
AI.result: 模型在不同数据库（MIT数据库和PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2021数据库）上表现出稳定的性能。摘要未报告具体的效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 该深度学习信号质量评估模型具有跨数据库的稳定性，并能结合情境数据解析复杂噪声，有望提升可穿戴心电监测的信号质量。但摘要未报告样本量及详细统计结果，需进一步验证其临床适用性。

summary_zh: 本文提出并评估了一种基于深度学习（DL）的信号质量评估（SQA）模型，用于区分干净和嘈杂的动态心电图（ECG）。该模型在哥本哈根健康技术情境化心律失常数据库（CACHET-CADB）上进行训练，据我们所知，这是第一个同时具有物理和患者报告情境数据的动态心电图数据库。该模型在MIT数据库和最新的PhysioNet/Cinc Challenge 2021数据库等不同数据库上表现出稳定的性能。随后，本文展示了如何通过SQA模型和物理情境数据来研究复杂的心电图噪声。

title: The Entropy Triangle Method (ETM): A novel framework for the prevention of cardiac arrhythmia with a review of more than 10,000 patients
summary: One of the most important problems in medicine is to facilitate prediction. In this study, we propose entropy triangle method, a novel framework for predicting heart rhythms using a novel machine learning technique. This framework includes three steps: feature engineering, entropy triangle oversampling, and disease prediction. The dataset used in this study is a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia research database with 10,646 patients. This dataset contains 11 different heart rhythms (5 sinus rhythms and 6 non-sinus rhythms). In this article, we introduce two firsts in machine learning and medicine that can predict non-sinus rhythm with over 85% accuracy. Our experimental results show, among others, that the most accurate classifier based on entropy triangles and the most useful oversampling are the supported vector classifiers and oversampling techniques for shark scent.

AI.tldr: 基于熵三角方法与机器学习框架，在10,646例12导联心电图数据中预测非窦性心律，准确率超过85%。
AI.motivation: 医学中预测心律失常仍具挑战，既往机器学习方法在非窦性心律识别上准确率有限，需探索新框架以提高预测性能。
AI.method: 研究提出熵三角方法（ETM）框架，包括特征工程、熵三角过采样和疾病预测三步。使用包含10,646例患者的12导联心电图心律失常研究数据库，涵盖11种心律（5种窦性、6种非窦性）。采用机器学习分类器（包括支持向量分类器）和过采样技术（包括鲨鱼气味过采样）进行预测，主要终点为非窦性心律预测准确率。摘要未报告具体终点定义细节和统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要报告非窦性心律预测准确率超过85%。基于熵三角的最准确分类器为支持向量分类器，最有效的过采样技术为鲨鱼气味过采样。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: 熵三角方法框架在大型心电图数据集中实现了较高的非窦性心律预测准确率，为心律失常预防提供了新思路。但摘要未报告外部验证和临床影响，需进一步研究验证其泛化性和实用性。

summary_zh: 医学中最重要的难题之一是促进预测。在本研究中，我们提出了熵三角方法（entropy triangle method），这是一种利用新型机器学习技术预测心脏节律的新框架。该框架包括三个步骤：特征工程、熵三角过采样和疾病预测。本研究使用的数据集是一个包含10,646名患者的12导联心电图（ECG）心律失常研究数据库。该数据集包含11种不同的心脏节律（5种窦性节律和6种非窦性节律）。在本文中，我们介绍了机器学习和医学领域的两个首创，它们能够以超过85%的准确率预测非窦性节律。我们的实验结果显示，基于熵三角形的最准确分类器和最有用的过采样分别是支持向量分类器和鲨鱼气味过采样技术。
